text:
Bismillah Surah Naml ki ek ayat ya? Sahaba ne Allah ki kitab ko isi se shuru kiya. Ulama ka ittefaq hai ke ayat (Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) Surah Naml ki ek ayat hai. Albatta is mein ikhtelaf hai ke woh har surat ke shuru mein khud mustaqil ayat hai? Ya har surat ki ek mustaqil ayat hai jo is ke shuru mein likhi gayi hai? Aur har surat ki ayat ka juzv hai? Ya sirf Surah Fatiha hi ki ayat hai aur doosri surton ki nahin? Sirf ek surat ko doosri surat se alaihda karne ke liye likhi gayi hai? Aur khud ayat nahin hai? Ulama-e-Salaf aur muta'akhireen ka in aara mein ikhtelaf chala aata hai in ki tafseel apni jagah par maujood hai. Sunan Abu Dawood mein sahih sanad ke sath Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) surton ki judayi nahin jaante the jab tak Aap par (Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) nazil nahin hoti thi. Yeh hadith Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai ek mursal hadith mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair se bhi marwi hai. Chunanche Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah mein Hazrat Umm-e-Salama se riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bismillah ko Surah Fatiha ke shuru mein namaz mein padha aur ise ek ayat shumar kiya lekin is ke ek rawi Umar bin Haroon Balkhi zaif hain isi mafhoom ki ek riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah se bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar, Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair, Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A), Hazrat Ata, Hazrat Taoos, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Makhool aur Hazrat Zuhri (Rahimahumullah / R.H) ka yehi mazhab hai ke Bismillah har surat ke aaghaz mein ek mustaqil ayat hai siwaye Surah Bara'at ke. In Sahaba aur Tabi'een ke alawa Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur Ishaq bin Rahwayh aur Abu Ubaidah Qasim bin Salam (Rahimahumullah / R.H) ka bhi yehi mazhab hai. Albatta Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa aur un ke saathi kehte hain ke Bismillah na to Surah Fatiha ki ayat hai na kisi aur surat ki. Imam Shafi'i ka ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Bismillah Surah Fatiha ki to ek ayat hai lekin kisi aur surat ki nahin. Un ka ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke har surat ke awwal ki ayat ka hissa hai lekin yeh donon qaul ghareeb hain. Dawood kehte hain ke har surat ke awwal mein Bismillah ek mustaqil ayat hai surat mein dakhil nahin. Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal se bhi yehi riwayat hai Abu Bakr Razi ne Abu Hasan Karkhi ka bhi yehi mazhab bayan kiya hai jo Imam Abu Hanifa ke bade paye ke saathi the. Yeh to thi bahas Bismillah ke Surah Fatiha ki ayat hone ya na hone ki. (Sahih mazhab yehi maloom hota hai ke jahan kahin Quran-e-Pak mein yeh ayat-e-sharifa hai wahan mustaqil ayat hai Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim) Bismillah ba-awaz-e-buland ya dabi awaz se? Ab is mein bhi ikhtelaf hai ke aaya ise ba-awaz-e-buland padhna chahiye ya past awaz se? Jo log ise Surah Fatiha ki ayat nahin kehte woh to ise buland awaz se padhne ke bhi qail nahin. Isi tarah jo log ise Surah Fatiha se alag ek ayat maante hain woh bhi is ke past awaz se padhne ke qail hain. Rahe woh log jo kehte hain ke yeh har surat ke awwal se hai.

In mein ikhtelaf hai. Shafi'i (Rahimahullah / R.H) ka mazhab hai ke Surah Fatiha aur har surat se pehle isay oonchi awaz se parhna chahiye. Sahaba, Tabi'een aur Musalmano ke muqaddam-o-muakhkhar imamein ki jama'aton ka yahi mazhab hai. Sahaba mein se isay oonchi awaz se parhne wale Hazrat Abu Hurairah, Hazrat Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hain. Baihaqi, Ibn Abdul Barr ne Hazrat Umar aur Hazrat Ali se bhi riwayat kiya aur Imam Khateeb Baghdadi ne charon khalifon se bhi riwayat kiya lekin sanad ghareeb bayan kiya hai. Tabi'een mein se Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair, Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Abu Qilabah, Hazrat Zuhri, Hazrat Ali bin Hasan un ke larke Muhammad, Sa'eed bin Musayyib, Ata, Ta'oos, Mujahid, Salim, Muhammad bin Ka'b Qurazi, Ubaid, Abu Bakr bin Muhammad bin Amr bin Hazm, Abu Wa'il, Ibn Sireen ke maula Zaid bin Aslam, Umar bin Abdul Aziz, Arzaq bin Qais, Habib bin Abi Thabit, Abu Sha'tha, Makhool, Abdullah bin Ma'qal bin Muqarrin aur ba-riwayat Baihaqi, Abdullah bin Safwan, Muhammad bin Hanafiyah aur ba-riwayat Ibn Abdul Barr, Amr bin Dinar (Rahimahumullah / R.H) sab ke sab in namazon mein jin mein qira'at oonchi awaz se parhi jati hai, Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem bhi buland awaz se parhte thay. Ek daleel to is ki yeh hai ke jab yeh ayat Surah Fatiha mein se hai to phir poori surat ki tarah yeh bhi oonchi awaz se hi parhni chahiye. Alawah azeen Sunan Nasai, Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah, Sahih Ibn Hibban, Mustadrak Hakim mein marwi hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne namaz parhayi aur qira'at mein oonchi awaz se Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem bhi parhi aur farigh hone ke baad farmaya mein tum sab se zyada Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath namaz mein mushabeh hoon. Is hadith ko Daraqutni, Khateeb aur Baihaqi waghera ne sahih kaha hai. Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz ko Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem se shuru kiya karte thay. Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain yeh hadith aisi zyada sahih nahin. Mustadrak Hakim mein unhi se riwayat hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem ko oonchi awaz se parhte thay. Imam Hakim ne isay sahih kaha hai. Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka andaz-e-qira'at Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Anas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se sawal kiya gaya ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qira'at kis tarah thi. Farmaya ke har khare lafz ko Aap lamba kar ke parhte thay phir Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem parh kar sunayi, Bismillah par madd kiya, Ar-Rahman par madd kiya, Ar-Raheem par madd kiya. Musnad Ahmad, Sunan Abu Dawood, Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah aur Mustadrak Hakim mein Hazrat Umm-e-Salamah (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har har ayat par rukte thay aur Aap ki qira'at alag alag hoti thi jaise Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem phir thehar kar Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil Aalameen phir thehar kar Ar-Rahmanir Raheem phir thehar kar Maliki Yawmid Deen. Daraqutni isay sahih batate hain. Imam Shafi'i, Imam Hakim ne Hazrat Anas se riwayat ki hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne Madinah mein namaz parhayi aur Bismillah na parhi to jo Muhajir as-hab wahan maujood thay unhon ne toka. Chunanche phir jab namaz parhane ko khare hue to Bismillah parhi.

Ghaliban itni hi ahadees-o-asar is mazhab ki hujjat ke liye kaafi hain. Baqi rahe is ke khilaf asar, riwayat, un ki sanadein, un ki taleel, un ka za'f aur un ki taqareer waghera un ka dusre maqam par zikr aur hai. Dusra mazhab yeh hai ke namaz mein Bismillah ko zor se na parhna chahiye. Khulafa-e-Arba'a aur Abdullah bin Mu'qal, tabieen aur baad walon ki jamaton se yahi sabit hai. Abu Hanifa, Thauri, Ahmad bin Hanbal ka bhi yahi mazhab hai. Imam Malik ka mazhab hai ke sire se Bismillah parhe hi nahin na to aahista na buland kiya. Un ki daleel ek to Sahih Muslim wali Hazrat Ayesha R.A ki riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ namaz ko takbeer se aur qirat ko Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen se hi shuru kiya karte the. Sahihain mein hai Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A farmate hain main ne Nabi ﷺ aur Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Umar R.A aur Hazrat Usman R.A ke peeche namaz parhi yeh sab Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen se shuru karte the. Muslim mein hai ke Bismillah nahin parhte the na to qirat ke shuru mein na is qirat ke aakhir mein. Sunan mein Hazrat Mu'qal R.A se bhi yahi marwi hai. Yeh hai daleel un aimma ke Bismillah aahista parhne ki. Yeh khayal rahe ke yeh koi bara ikhtilaf nahin har ek fareeq dusre ki namaz ki sehat ka qail hai. Falhamdulillah (Bismillah ka mutlaq na parhna to theek nahin. Buland-o-past parhne ki ahadees mein is tarah tatbeeq ho sakti hai ke dono jaiz hain. Go past parhne ki ahadees qadre zor-dar hain Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim). Fasl: Bismillah ki fazeelat ka bayan. Tafsir Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem ki nisbat sawal kiya aap ne farmaya yeh Allah Ta'ala ka naam hai. Allah Ta'ala ke bare namon aur is mein is qadar nazdeki hai jaise aankh ki siyahi aur safedi mein. Ibn Marduyah mein bhi yahi ki riwayat hai. Ibn Marduyah yeh bhi riwayat karte hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jab Isa A.S ko un ki walida ne muallim ke paas bithaya to us ne kaha likhiye Bismillah. Hazrat Isa A.S ne kaha Bismillah kya hai? Ustad ne jawab diya main nahin jaanta. Aap ne farmaya "Ba" se murad Allah Ta'ala ka "Baha" yani bulandi hai aur "Seen" se murad us ki "Sana" yani noor aur roshni hai aur "Meem" se murad us ki "Mamlikat" yani badshahi hai aur "Allah" kehte hain maboodon ke mabood ko aur "Rahman" kehte hain duniya aur aakhirat mein raham karne wale ko, "Raheem" kehte hain aakhirat mein karam-o-raham karne wale ko. Ibn Jareer mein bhi yahi riwayat hai lekin sanad ki ro se yeh behad ghareeb hai, mumkin hai kisi sahabi waghera se marwi ho aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke Bani Israel ki riwayaton mein se ho. Marfoo hadith na ho Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Marduyah mein manqool hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya mujh par ek aisi aayat utri hai jo kisi aur Nabi par siwaye Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke nahin utri. Woh aayat Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem hai. Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain jab yeh aayat "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" utri badal mashriq ki taraf chhat gaye. Hawaein sakin ho gayin.

Samandar thehar gaya, janwaron ne kaan laga liye. Shayateen par aasman se sholay gire aur Parwardigar-e-Alam ne apni izzat-o-jalal ki qasam kha kar farmaya ke jis cheez par mera yeh naam liya jayega us mein zaroor barkat hogi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke Jahannam ke unnees darogon se jo bachna chahe woh Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim parhe. Is ke bhi unnees huroof hain. Har harf har farishtay se bachao ban jayega. Isay Ibn-e-Atiyyah ne bayan kiya hai, is ki tayeed ek aur hadees se bhi hai jis mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Main ne tees se oopar farishton ko dekha ke woh jaldi kar rahe thay." Yeh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt farmaya tha jab ek shakhs ne 'Rabbana wa lakal hamd, hamdan kaseeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh' parha tha. Is mein bhi tees se oopar huroof hain, utne hi farishtay utray. Isi tarah Bismillah mein bhi unnees huroof hain aur wahan farishton ki tadaad bhi unnees hai, waghera waghera. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sawari par Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Yeh na kaho, is se shaitan phoolta hai aur khayal karta hai ke goya us ne apni quwwat se giraya. Haan, Bismillah kehne se woh makkhi ki tarah zaleel-o-past ho jata hai." Nasai ne apni kitab 'Amal-ul-Yaum-wal-Lailah' mein aur Ibn-e-Marduyah ne apni tafsir mein bhi isay naqal kiya hai aur sahabi ka naam Usama bin Umair bataya hai. Is mein yeh likha hai ke Bismillah keh kar Bismillah ki barkat se shaitan zaleel hoga. Isi liye har kaam aur har baat ke shuru mein Bismillah keh lena mustahab hai. Khutba ke shuru mein bhi Bismillah kehni chahiye. Hadees mein hai ke jis kaam ko Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim se shuru na kiya jaye woh be-barkata hota hai. Pakhana mein jaane ke waqt Bismillah parh le. Hadees mein yeh bhi hai ke wuzu ke waqt bhi parh le. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Sunan mein Abu Hurairah, Saeed bin Zaid aur Abu Saeed (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Jo shakhs wuzu mein Allah ka naam na le us ka wuzu nahin hota." Yeh hadees hasan hai. Baaz ulama to wuzu ke waqt aaghaz mein Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim parhna wajib batate hain. Baaz mutlaq wujoob ke qail hain. Janwar ko zibah karte waqt bhi is ka parhna mustahab hai. Imam Shafi (R.H) aur ek jamaat ka yahi khayal hai. Baaz ne yaad aane ke waqt aur baaz ne mutlaqan isay wajib kaha hai. Is ka tafseeli bayan anqareeb aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Imam Razi (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein is ayat ki fazeelat mein bohat si ahadees naqal ki hain. Ek mein hai ke, "Jab tu apni biwi ke paas jaye aur Bismillah parh le aur Allah koi aulad bakhshe to us ke apne aur us ki aulad ke saanson ki ginti ke barabar tere nam-e-aamal mein nekiyan likhi jayengi." Lekin yeh riwayat bilkul be-asal hai, main ne to yeh kahin kisi motabar kitab mein nahin payi. Khate waqt bhi Bismillah parhni mustahab hai. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke, "Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Umar bin Abu Salama se farmaya (jo Aap ki parwarish mein Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Umm-e-Salama ke aglay khawand se thay) ke Bismillah kaho aur apne dahne haath se khaya karo aur apne samne se niwala uthaya karo."

Ba'az ulama is waqt bhi Bismillah ka kehna wajib batlate hain. Biwi se milne ke waqt bhi Bismillah parhni chahiye. Sahihain mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke "Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya jab tum mein se koi apni biwi se milne ka irada kare to yeh parhe: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaitana wa jannibish-shaitana ma razaqtana, ya'ni ae Allah hamein aur jo hamein tu de use shaitan se bacha." Farmate hain ke agar is jama' se hamal thehar jaye to is bacha ko shaitan kabhi nuqsan na pohancha sake ga. Yahan se yeh bhi maloom hua ke Bismillah ki "Ba" ka ta'alluq kis se hai. Nahwiyon ke is mein do qaul hain aur dono hi taqreeban hum-khayal hain. Ba'az ism kehte hain aur ba'az fe'l, har ek ki daleel Quran se milti hai. Jo log ism ke sath muta'alliq batate hain woh to kehte hain ke Bismillah ibtidai ya'ni Allah ke naam se meri ibtida hai. Quran mein hai: Irkabu feeha (Bismillahi majreha wa mursaha) (Surah Hud: 41). Is mein ism ya'ni masdar zahir kar diya gaya hai aur jo log fe'l muqaddar batate hain chahe woh amr ho ya khabar. Jaise ke abda'u Bismillah aur ibtada'tu Bismillah, un ki daleel ayat: Iqra' bismi. Dar-asal dono hi sahih hain, is liye ke fe'l ke liye bhi masdar ka hona zaroori hai to ikhtiyar hai ke fe'l ko muqaddar mana jaye aur us ke masdar ko mutabiq us fe'l ke jis ka naam pehle liya gaya hai. Khara hona, baithna ho, khana ho, peena ho, Quran ka parhna ho, wuzu aur namaz waghera ho, in sab ke shuru mein barkat hasil karne ke liye, imdad chahne ke liye aur qabooliyat ke liye Allah Ta'ala ka naam lena mashroo' hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jarir aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein riwayat hai: "Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke jab sab se pehle Jibraeel A.S Muhammad ﷺ par wahi le kar aaye to farmaya: Ae Muhammad! kahiye: A'oodhu billahis-samee'il-'aleemi minash-shaitanir-rajeem, phir kaha kahiye: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Maqsood yeh tha ke uthna, baithna, parhna sab Allah ke naam se shuru ho." Be-ma'ni behas: Ism ya'ni naam hi musamma ya'ni naam wala hai ya kuch aur, is mein ahl-e-ilm ke teen qaul hain. Ek to yeh ke ism hi musamma hai. Abu Ubaidah ka aur Sibawaih ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Baqillani aur Ibn-e-Noor ki raye bhi yahi hai. Ibn-e-Khateeb Razi apni tafseer ke muqaddamat mein likhte hain: Hashwiyah aur Karamiyah aur Ash'ariyah to kehte hain ism nafs-e-musamma hai aur nafs-e-tasmiyah ka ghair hai aur Mu'tazilah kehte hain ke ism musamma ka ghair hai aur nafs-e-tasmiyah hai. Hamare nazdeek ism musamma ka bhi ghair hai aur tasmiyah ka bhi. Hum kehte hain ke agar ism se murad lafz hai jo awazon ke tukron aur huroof ka majmo'a hai to bil-badahat sabit hai ke yeh musamma ka ghair hai aur agar ism se murad zaat-e-musamma hai to yeh wazahat ko zahir karta hai jo mehez bekar hai. Sabit hua ke is bekar behas mein parna hi fazool hai. Is ke baad jo log ism aur musamma ke farq par apne dalail laye hain un ka kehna hai mehez ism hota hai musamma hota hi nahin jaise ma'doom ka lafz. Kabhi ek musamma ke kayi ism hote hain jaise mushtarak.

Is se maloom hota hai ke ism aur cheez hai aur musamma aur cheez hai yani naam alag hai aur naam wala alag hai. Aur daleel suniye, kehte hain ism toh lafz hai, dusra arz hai. Musamma kabhi mumkin ya wajib zaat hoti hai. Aur suniye agar ism hi ko musamma mana jaye toh chahiye ke aag ka naam lete hi hararat mehsoos ho aur barf ka naam lete hi thandak, jabke koi aqalmand is ki tasdeeq nahin karta. Aur daleel suniye Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Allah ke bohat se behtareen naam hain, tum un naamon se use pukaro. Hadees-e-Shareef hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke ninnanve (99) naam hain toh khayal kijiye ke naam kis qadar bakasrat hain halanke musamma ek hi hai aur woh Allah Ta'ala wahdahu la sharika lahu hai. Isi tarah asma ko Allah ki taraf is aayat mein muzaf karna, aur jagah farmana "Fasabbih bismi rabbikal azeem" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 74) wagaira, yeh izafat bhi isi ka taqaza karti hai ke ism aur ho aur musamma aur, kyunke izafat ka muqtaza mugahayarat hai. Isi tarah yeh "Wa lillahil asmaul husna fad'uhu biha" (Surah Al-A'raf: 180) yani Allah Ta'ala ko us ke naamon ke sath pukaro. Yeh bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke naam aur hai aur naam wala aur. Ab un ke dalail bhi suniye jo ism aur musamma ko ek hi batate hain, toh naam barkaton wala farmaya halanke khud Allah Ta'ala barkaton wala hai. Is ka aasaan jawab yeh hai ke us muqaddas zaat ki wajah se us ka naam bhi azmaton wala hai. Un ki dusri daleel yeh hai ke jab koi shakhs kahe ke Zainat par talaq hai toh talaq us ki biwi jis ka naam Zainat hai ho jati hai. Agar naam aur naam wale mein farq hota toh naam par talaq padti, naam wale par kaise padti? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke is se murad yahi hoti hai ke us zaat par talaq hai jis ka naam Zainat hai. Tasmiya ka ism se alag hona is daleel ki bina par hai ke tasmiya kehte hain kisi ka naam muqarrar karne ko aur zahir hai yeh aur cheez hai aur naam wala aur cheez hai. Razi (R.H) ka qaul yahi hai ke yeh sab kuch toh lafz "Bism" ke mutaliq tha, ab lafz "Allah" ke mutaliq suniye. Allah khas naam hai Rabb-e-Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka. Kaha jata hai ke Ism-e-Azam yahi hai is liye ke tamam umda siftaton ke sath hi mausuf hota hai. Jaise ke Quran-e-Pak mein hai "Huwallahul lazi" (Surah Al-Hashr: 22) yani wahi Allah hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin jo zahir-o-batin ka janne wala hai, jo raham karne wala meharban hai. Wahi Allah jis ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, jo badshah hai, pak hai, salamti wala hai, aman dene wala hai, muhafiz hai, galba wala hai, zabardast hai, badai wala hai, woh har shirk se aur shirk ki cheez se pak hai. Wahi Allah paida karne wala, madda ko banane wala, surat bakhshne wala hai. Us ke liye behtareen pakeeza naam hain, aasman-o-zameen ki tamam cheezein us ki tasbeeh bayan karti hain. Woh izzaton aur hikmaton wala hai. In aayaton mein tamam naam sifati hain, aur lafz Allah hi ki sifat hain yani asli naam Allah hai. Dusri jagah farmaya ke Allah hi ke liye hain pakeeza aur umda umda naam.

Allah Ta'ala ne apne tamam (sifati) naam khud tajweez farmaye hain. Pas tum us ko un hi naamon se pukaro. Aur farmata hai Allah ko pukaro, ya Rahman ko pukaro, jis naam se pukaro, usi ke pyare pyare aur achhe achhe naam hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke ninnanwe (99) naam hain. Ek kam ek sau, jo unhein yaad kar le jannati hai. Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah ki riwayat mein un naamon ki tafseel bhi aayi hai aur dono ki riwayaton mein alfaaz ki kuch tabdeeli, kuch kami ziyadati bhi hai. Razi (R.H) ne apni tafseer mein baaz logon se riwayat ki hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke paanch hazaar naam hain. Ek hazaar toh Quran-e-Sharif aur Sahih Hadith mein hain aur ek hazaar Taurat mein aur ek hazaar Injeel mein aur ek hazaar Zaboor mein aur ek hazaar Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein. Allah ke mutaradif-ul-ma'ni koi naam nahin! Allah hi woh naam hai jo siwaye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ke kisi aur ka nahin. Yehi wajah hai ke aaj tak Arab ko yeh bhi maloom nahin ke is ka ishtiqaq kya hai, is ka baab kya hai, balkeh ek bahut badi nahwiyon ki jamaat ka khayal hai ke yeh ism-e-jamid hai aur is ka koi ishtiqaq hai hi nahin. Qurtubi (R.H) ne ulama-e-kiram ki ek badi jamaat ka yehi mazhab naqal kiya hai jin mein Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H), Imam Khattabi (R.H), Imam-ul-Harmain (R.H), Imam Ghazali (R.H) bhi shamil hain. Khalil aur Sibwaih se riwayat hai ke Alif-Laam is mein lazim hai. Imam Khattabi (R.H) ne is ki ek daleel yeh di hai ke "Ya Allah" asal kalma ka na hota toh is par nida ka lafz "Ya" dakhil na ho sakta, kyunke qawaid-e-Arabi ke lihaz se harf-e-nida ka Alif-Laam wale ism par dakhil hona jaiz nahin. Baaz logon ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke yeh mushtaq hai aur is par Ruba bin Lajjaj ka ek sher daleel late hain jis mein masdar "Ta'alluh" ka bayan hai jis ka mazi muzare "Alaha, Ya'lahu, Alahatan aur Ta'alluhan" hai, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke woh "Wa Yadharuka Aalihataka" parhte thay, murad is se ibadat hai. Ya'ni us ki ibadat ki jati hai aur woh kisi ki ibadat nahin karta. Mujahid (R.H) waghera kehte hain. Baaz ne is par is aayat se daleel pakdi hai ke aayat (Wa Huwallahu Fis-Samawati Wa Fil-Ard) (Surah Al-An'am: 3) aur aayat mein hai (Wa Huwalladhi Fis-Sama'i Ilahun Wa Fil-Ardi Ilahun) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 84) ya'ni wohi Allah hai aasmanon mein aur zameen mein. Wohi hai jo aasman mein mabood hai aur zameen mein mabood hai. Sibwaih, Khalil se naqal karte hain ke asal mein yeh "Ilah" tha jaise "Fa'al", phir hamza ke badle Alif-o-Laam laya gaya jaise "An-Naas" ke us ki asal "Unaas" hai. Baaz ne kaha hai ke is lafz ki asal "Alah" hai, Alif-Laam harf-e-ta'zeem ke taur par laya gaya hai. Sibwaih ka bhi pasandida qaul yehi hai. Arab shairon ke sheron mein bhi yeh lafz milta hai.

Kisai aur Farra kehte hain ke is ki asal Al-Ilah thi, hamza ko hazf kiya aur pehle laam ko dusre mein idgham kiya, jaise ke aayat (Lakinna huwallahu Rabbi wa la ushriku bi Rabbi ahada) (Surah Al-Kahf: 38) mein Lakin ana ka Lakinna hua hai. Chunancha Hasan ki qira'at mein Lakin ana hi hai aur is ka ishtiqaq walah se hai aur is ke ma'ani tahayyur hain, walah aql ke chale jaane ko kehte hain, jab woh jungle mein bhej diya jaaye. Chunke Zaat-e-Bari Ta'ala mein aur is ki sifaton ki tahqeeq mein aql hairan-o-pareshan ho jaati hai, is liye is paak zaat ko Allah kaha jaata hai. Is bina par asal mein yeh lafz Walah tha, waw ko hamza se badal diya gaya jaise ke wishah aur wisadah mein ishah aur isadah kehte hain. Razi kehte hain ke yeh lafz Alah-tu-ila-fulan se mushtaq hai jo ke ma'ani mein "sakanat" ke hai, ya'ni main ne fulaan se sukoon aur rahat hasil ki. Chunke aql ka sukoon sirf Zaat-e-Bari Ta'ala ke zikr se hai aur rooh ki haqeeqi khushi is ki ma'rifat mein hai, is liye ke ala-al-itlaq kaamil wahi hai, is ke siwa aur koi nahin, isi wajah se Allah kaha jaata hai. Quran Majeed mein hai aayat (Ala bi zikrillahi tatma'innul quloob) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 28), ya'ni imandaron ke dil sirf Allah Ta'ala ke zikr se hi itminan hasil karte hain. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh laaha-yaloohu se ma'khuz hai jis ke ma'ani chup jaane aur hijab karne ke hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke ilah al-faseel se hai, chunke bande isi ki taraf tadarru aur zaari se jhukte hain, isi ke daaman-e-rahmat ka palla har haal mein thaamte hain, is liye ise Allah kaha gaya. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Arab alaha-ar-rajulu-yalahu us waqt kehte hain jab kisi achanak amr se koi ghabra uthe aur dusra use panah de aur bacha le, chunke tamam makhlooq ko har museebat se najaat dene wala Allah Subhanuhu wa Ta'ala hai, is liye is ko Allah kehte hain. Jaise ke Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Wa huwa yujeeru wa la yujaru alaihi) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 88), ya'ni wahi bachata hai aur is ke muqabil mein koi nahin bachaya jaata. (Wa huwa mun'im) haqeeqi mun'im wahi farmata hai tumhare paas jitni ne'matein hain woh sab Allah Ta'ala ki di hui hain, wahi mut'im hai farmaya hai woh khilata hai aur use koi nahin khilata. Wahi mujid hai farmaya hai har cheez ka wujood Allah ki taraf se hai. Razi ka mukhtar mazhab yahi hai ke lafz Allah mushtaq nahin hai. Khalil, Sibawayh, aksar usooliyon aur fuqaha ka yahi qaul hai, is ki bahut si daleelein bhi hain, agar yeh mushtaq hota to is ke ma'ani mein bahut se afraad ki shirkat hoti halanke aisa nahin, phir is lafz ko mausuf banaya jaata hai aur bahut si is ki sifatein aati hain jaise Rahman, Rahim, Maalik, Quddus waghera, to maloom hua ke yeh mushtaq nahin. Quran mein ek jagah aayat (Azizil Hamid. Allah) al-kh jo aata hai wahan yeh atf-e-bayaan hai. Ek daleel hai is ke mushtaq na hone ki yeh bhi hai aayat (Hal ta'lamu lahu samiyya), ya'ni kya is ka hum-naam bhi koi jaante ho? Lekin yeh ghaur talab hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Baaz logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke yeh lafz Ibrani hai lekin Razi ne is qaul ko zaeef kaha hai aur filwaqai zaeef hai bhi. Razi farmate hain ke "Makhlooq ki do qismein hain, ek woh jo marifat-e-Ilahi ke kinare par pahunch gaye, dusre woh jo is se mehroom hain, jo hairat ke andheron mein aur jahalat ki pur-khar wadiyon mein pade hain, woh toh aql ko kho baithe aur roohani kamalaat ko kho baithe hain, lekin jo sahil-e-marifat par pahunch chuke hain, jo nooraniyat ke wasee baghon mein ja thahre, jo kibriyai aur jalal ki wusat ka andaza kar chuke hain, woh bhi yahan tak pahunch kar hairan-o-shashdar reh gaye hain. Garz saari makhlooq is ki poori marifat se aajiz aur sar-gashta-o-hairan hai." In ma'ani ki bina par is pak zaat ka naam Allah hai. Saari makhlooq is ki mohtaj, is ke samne jhukne wali aur is ki talash karne wali hai. Is haqeeqat ki wajah se ise Allah kehte hain. Jaisa ke Khalil ka qaul hai, Arab ke muhawre mein har unchi aur buland cheez ko "Lah" kehte hain. Suraj jab tulu hota hai tab bhi woh kehte hain "Laahat-ush-Shams". Chunke Parwardigar-e-Alam bhi sab se buland-o-bala hai, is ko bhi Allah kehte hain. Aur Ilah ke ma'ani ibadat karne aur Talah ke ma'ani hukm-bardari aur qurbani ke hain aur Rabb-e-Alam ki ibadat ki jati hai aur is ke naam par qurbaniyan ki jati hain, is liye ise Allah kehte hain. Ibn Abbas R.A ki qirat mein hai "Wa yazaruka wa alihataka", is ki asal Al-Ilah hai, pas sirf kalma ki jagah jo hamza hai woh hazf kiya gaya. Phir nafs-e-kalma ka laam zaid laam se jo tareef ke liye laya gaya hai mila diya gaya, phir ek ko dusre mein mudgham kar diya toh ek laam-e-mushaddad reh gaya aur taziman Allah kaha gaya. Yeh toh tafseer-e-lafz "Allah" ki thi. Ar-Rahman aur Ar-Rahim ke ma'ani: Ayat (Ar-Rahman-ir-Rahim) ka bayan aayega, yeh dono naam rahmat se mushtaq hain. Donon mein mubaligha hai, Ar-Rahman mein Rahim se zyada mubaligha hai. Allama Ibn-e-Jarir ke qaul se maloom hota hai woh bhi in ma'ani se muttafiq hain, goya is par ittefaq hai. Baaz salaf ki tafseeron se bhi yahi maloom hota hai. In ma'ani par mabni Hazrat Isa A.S ka qaul bhi pehle guzar chuka hai ke Rahman se murad duniya aur aakhirat mein raham karne wala aur Rahim se murad aakhirat mein raham karne wala hai. Baaz log kehte hain ke Rahman mushtaq nahin hai, agar yeh is tarah hota toh marhoom ke sath milta. Halankeh Quran mein "Bil-muminina Rahima" aaya hai. Mubarrad kehte hain Rahman Ibrani naam hai, Arabi nahin. Abu Ishaq Zajjaj Ma'ani-ul-Quran mein kehte hain ke Ahmad bin Yahya ka qaul hai ke Rahim Arabi lafz hai aur Rahman Ibrani hai, donon ko jama kar diya gaya hai. Lekin Abu Ishaq farmate hain, "Is qaul ko dil nahin manta." Qurtubi farmate hain, "Is lafz ke mushtaq hone ki yeh daleel hai ke Tirmidhi ki sahih hadith hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke main Rahman hoon, main ne raham ko paida kiya aur apne naam mein se hi is ka naam mushtaq kiya. Is ke milane wale ko main milaunga aur is ke todne wale ko kaat doonga."

Is sareeh hadith ke hote hue mukhalifat aur inkar karne ki koi gunjaish nahin. Raha kuffar-e-Arab ka is naam se inkar karna, yeh mehez unki jahalat ka ek karishma tha. Qurtubi R.H kehte hain ke "Rahman aur Rahim ke ek hi ma'ani hain aur jaise nadman aur nadeem." Abu Ubaid ka bhi yahi khayal hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke fa'lan fa'eel ki tarah nahin. Fa'lan mein mubalagha zaroori hota hai jaise ghazban usi shakhs ko keh sakte hain jo bahut hi gussa wala ho aur fa'eel sirf fa'il aur sirf maf'ool ke liye bhi aata hai jo mubalagha se khali hota hai. Abu Ali Farsi R.H kehte hain ke "Rahman aam ism hai jo har qism ki rehmaton ko shamil hai aur sirf Allah Ta'ala ke sath makhsoos hai. Rahim ba'etibar mominon ke hai, farmaya hai aayat (Wa kana bil-mu'mineena raheema) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 43) mominon ke sath raheem hai." Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain "Yeh dono rehmat-o-reham wale hain, ek mein dusre se zyada rehmat-o-reham hai." Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ki is riwayat mein lafz arq hai, iske ma'ani Khattabi waghera arfaq karte hain jaise ke hadith mein hai ke "Allah Ta'ala rafeeq yani shafeeq aur meherbani wala hai, woh har kaam mein narmi aur aasani ko pasand karta hai, woh dusron par narmi aur aasani karne wale par woh ne'matein marhamat farmata hai jo sakhti karne wale par ata nahin farmata." Ibn Mubarak R.H farmate hain "Rahman use kehte hain ke jab us se jo manga jaye ata farmaye aur Rahim woh hai ke jab us se na manga jaye woh ghazabnak ho." Tirmidhi ki hadith mein hai "Jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala se na mange, Allah Ta'ala us par ghazabnak hota hai." Ba'az shairon ka qaul hai: Allah yaghzabu in tarakta suwalahu, wa bani adama heena yus'alu yaghzabu. Yani Allah Ta'ala se na mango to woh naraz hota hai aur Bani Adam se mango to woh bigadte hain. Uzrami R.H farmate hain ke Rahman ke ma'ani tamam makhlooq par reham karne wala aur Rahim ke ma'ani mominon par reham karne wala hai. Dekhiye Quran-e-Kareem ki do aayaton, aayat (Summastawa 'alal arsh) aur (Ar-Rahmanu 'alal arshi istawa) mein istawa ke sath Rahman ka lafz zikr kiya taake tamam makhlooq ko yeh lafz apne aam reham-o-karam ke ma'ani se shamil ho sake aur mominon ke zikr ke sath lafz Rahim farmaya, aayat (Wa kana bil-mu'mineena raheema) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 43). Pas maloom hua ke Rahman mein mubalagha ba-nisbat Rahim ke bahut zyada hai. Lekin hadith ki ek dua mein "Ya Rahmanad-dunya wal-akhirati wa raheemahuma" bhi aaya hai. Rahman yeh naam bhi Allah Ta'ala ke sath makhsoos hai. Is ke siwa kisi dusre ka naam nahin. Jaise ke farman hai ke Allah ko pukaro ya Rahman ko, jis naam se chaho use pukaro, us ke bahut achhe achhe naam hain. Ek aur aayat mein hai, aayat (Was'al man arsalna min qablika min rusulina aj'alna min doonir-Rahmani aalihatan yu'badoon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 45).

(Az-Zukhruf: 45) Ya'ni un se pooch lo tujh se pehle hum ne jo Rasool bheje thay kya unhon ne Rahman ke siwa kisi ko mabood kaha tha ke un ki ibadat ki jaye. Jab Musailima Kazzab ne barh charh kar da'we shuru kiye aur apna naam Rahman-ul-Yamama rakha toh Parwardigar ne use be-inteha ruswa aur barbad kiya, woh jhoot aur kazb ki alamat mashhoor ho gaya. Aaj use Musailima Kazzab kaha jata hai aur har jhoote da'wedar ko us ke sath tashbeeh di jati hai. Har dehati aur shehri har kachche pakke ghar wala use bakhoobi janta hai. Ba'az kehte hain ke Rahim mein Rahman se zyada mubalagha hai is liye ke is lafz ke sath agle lafz ki takeed ki gayi hai aur takeed ba-nisbat us ke ke jis ki takeed jaye zyada qawi hoti hai. Is ka jawab yeh hai ke yahan takeed hai hi nahin balkeh yeh toh sifat hai aur sifat mein yeh qaida nahin. Pas Allah Ta'ala ka naam liya gaya is naam mein bhi is ka koi shareek nahin, sab se pehle is ki sifat Rahman bayan ki gayi aur yeh naam rakhna bhi dusron ko mamnoo hai jaise farma diya ke Allah ko ya Rahman ko pukaro jis naam se chaho pukaro us ke liye Asma-e-Husna bahut sare hain. Musailima ne badtareen jurrat ki lekin barbad hua aur us ke gumrah sathiyon ke siwa is ki kisi ke dil mein na aayi. Rahim ke wasf ke sath Allah Ta'ala ne dusron ko bhi mausuf kiya hai. Farmata hai ayat (Laqad ja'akum) al-kh. Is ayat mein apne Nabi ko Rahim kaha, isi tarah apne ba'az aise namon se dusron ko bhi us ne wabasta kiya hai. Jaise ayat (Inna khalaqnal insana min nutfatin amshajin) (76. Al-Insan: 2) mein insaan ko Samee aur Baseer kaha hai. Hasil yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke ba'az naam toh aise hain ke dusron par bhi hum-ma'ani hone ka itlaq ho sakta hai aur ba'az aise hain ke nahin ho sakta jaise Allah aur Rahman, Khaliq aur Razzaq waghera isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne apna pehla naam Allah phir is ki sifat Rahman se ki. Is liye ke Rahim ki nisbat yeh zyada khaas hai aur zyada mashhoor hai. Qaida hai ke awwal sab se zyada buzurg naam liya jata hai, is liye sab se pehle sab se zyada khaas naam liya gaya phir us se kam. Phir us se kam. Agar kaha jaye ke jab Rahman mein Rahim se zyada mubalagha majood hai phir isi par iktifa kyun na kiya gaya? Toh is ke jawab mein Hazrat Atta Khurasani ka yeh qaul pesh kiya ja sakta hai ke chunke kafiron ne Rahman ka naam bhi ghairon ka rakh liya tha is liye Rahim ka lafz bhi sath lagaya gaya taake kisi qisam ka weham hi na rahe. Rahman-o-Rahim sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ka naam hai. Ibn-e-Jareer ne taham is qaul ki tasdeeq ki hai. Ba'az log kehte hain ke jahiliyat ke zamane ke Arab Rahman se waqif hi na thay, yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne Quran-e-Pak ki ayat (Qulid'ullaha awid'ur-Rahmana ayyam-ma tad'oo falahul asma'ul husna) (17. Al-Isra: 110) nazil farma kar un ki tardeed ki.

Hudaibiyah wale saal jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se farmaya tha ke Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim likho toh kuffar ne kaha tha ke hum Rahman aur Rahim ko nahin jante. Bukhari mein yeh riwayat majood hai. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke unhon ne kaha tha ke hum Rahman-e-Yamamah ko jante hain kisi aur Rahman ko nahin jante. Isi tarah Quran-e-Pak mein hai aayat (Wa iza qeela lahumus judu lir-Rahmani qalu wa mar-Rahmanu anasjudu lima ta'muruna wa zadahum nufura) (Surah Al-Furqan: 60) yani jab un se kaha jata hai ke Rahman ke samne sajda karo toh woh hairan zada ho kar jawab dete hain ke Rahman kaun hai? Jise hum tere qaul ki wajah se sajda karein. Darhaqiqat yeh badkar log sirf inaad, takabbur, sarkashi aur dushmani ki bina par Rahman se inkar karte the na ke woh is naam se na-ashna the. Is liye ke jahiliyat ke zamane ke purane ashaar mein bhi Allah Ta'ala ka naam Rahman majood hai jo inhi ke Salamah aur dusre shu'ara ke ashaar mein mulahiza ho. Tafsir Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se ke Rahman Fa'lan ke wazan par Rahmat se ma'khuz hai aur kalam-e-Arab se hai. Woh Allah rafiq aur raqiq hai jis par raham karna chahe aur jis se gusse ho us se bahut door aur us par bahut sakht-gir bhi hai isi tarah us ke tamam naam hain. Hasan (R.H) farmate hain Rahman ka naam dusron ke liye mana hai. Khud Allah Ta'ala ka naam hai log is naam par koi haq nahin rakhte. Umm-e-Salama (R.A) wali hadith jis mein ke har aayat par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) thahra karte the, pehle guzar chuki hai aur ek jamaat isi tarah Bismillah ko aayat qarar de kar aayat-e-Alhamdulillah ko alag padhti hai aur baaz mila kar padhte hain. Meem ko do sakin jama ho jane ki wajah se zer dete hain. Jamhoor ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Kufi kehte hain ke baaz Arab meem ke zer se padhte hain, hamza ki harkat zabar meem ko dete hain. Jaise aayat (Alif-Laam-Meem. Allahu la ilaha illa hu). Ibn-e-Atiyyah kehte hain ke zabar ki qira'at kisi se bhi mere khayal mein marwi nahin. Aayat (Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim) ki tafsir khatam hui ab aage suniye.

Saaton qari Al-Hamdu ko daal par pesh se parhte hain aur Al-Hamdulillah ko mubtada khabar maante hain. Sufyan bin Uyaynah aur Rubah bin Ajjaj ka qaul hai ke daal par zabar ke saath hai aur fe'l yahan muqaddar hai. Ibn Abi Ablah Al-Hamdu ki daal ko aur Allah ke pehle laam dono ko pesh ke saath parhte hain aur is laam ko pehle ke taabi karte hain agarche is ki shahadat arabi zaban mein milti hai magar is ki shahadat zaban-e-Arab se milti hai shaaz hai. Hasan aur Zaid bin Ali in dono harfon ko zer se parhte hain aur laam ke taabi daal ko karte hain. Ibn Jarir farmate hain "Al-Hamdulillah ke ma'ni yeh hain ke sirf Allah Ta'ala ka shukr hai is ke siwa koi is ke laiq nahin, khwah woh makhlooq mein se koi bhi ho is wajah se ke tamam ne'matein jinhein hum gin bhi nahin sakte, is maalik ke siwa aur koi in ki tadaad ko nahin jaanta isi ki taraf se hain. Isi ne apni ita'at karne ke tamam asbaab hamein ata farmaye. Isi ne apne faraiz poore karne ke liye tamam jismani ne'matein hamein bakhshein. Phir beshumar dunyawi ne'matein aur zindagi ki tamam zarooriyaat hamare kisi haq baghair hamein bin mange bakhshein. Is ki lazawaal ne'matein, is ke tayyar karda pakeeza maqam jannat ko hum kis tarah hasil kar sakte hain? Yeh bhi us ne hamein sikha diya pas hum to kehte hain ke awwal aakhir isi maalik ki paak zaat har tarah ki tareef aur hamd-o-shukr ke shaiq hai. Al-Hamdulillah yeh sana ka kalma hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apni sana khud aap ki hai aur isi zimn mein yeh farma diya hai ke tum kaho Al-Hamdulillah." Baaz ne kaha ke Al-Hamdulillah kehna Allah Ta'ala ke pakeeza naamon aur is ki buland-o-bala sifaton se is ki sana karna hai. Aur Ash-Shukru lillah kehna Allah Ta'ala ki ne'maton aur is ke ehsaan ka shukriya ada karna hai. Lekin yeh qaul theek nahin. Is liye ke arabi zaban ko janne wale ulama ka ittefaq hai ke shukr ki jagah hamd ka lafz aur hamd ki jagah shukr ka lafz bolte hain. Ja'far Sadiq, Ibn Ata Sufi bhi farmate hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke har shukr karne wale ka kalma Al-Hamdulillah hai. Qurtubi ne Ibn Jarir ke qaul ko mo'tabar karne ke liye yeh daleel bhi bayan ki hai ke agar koi Al-Hamdulillah shukran kahe to jaiz hai. Dar-asal Allama Ibn Jarir ke is da'we mein ikhtilaf hai, pichle ulama mein mashhoor hai ke hamd kehte hain zabani tareef bayan karne ko khwah jis ki hamd ki jaati ho is ki lazim sifaton par ho ya muta'addi sifaton par aur shukr sirf muta'addi sifaton par hota hai aur woh dil zaban aur jumla arkaan se hota hai. Arab shairon ke ashaar bhi is par daleel hain, haan is mein ikhtilaf hai ke hamd ka lafz aam hai ya shukr ka aur sahih baat yeh hai ke is mein umoom is haisiyat se khusoos hai ke hamd ka lafz jis par waqay ho woh aam taur par shukr ke ma'non mein aata hai.

Is liye ke woh lazim aur muta'addi dono ausaf par aata hai, shah-sawari aur karam dono par hamd-e-tah keh sakte hain lekin is haisiyat se woh sirf zaban se ada ho sakta hai. Yeh lafz khas aur shukr ka lafz aam hai kyunke woh qaul, fe'l aur niyat teeno par bola jata hai aur sirf muta'addi sifaton par bole jane ke aitbar se shukr ka lafz khas hai. Shah-sawari ke husool par shukrtahu nahin keh sakte, albatta shukrtahu ala karamihi wa ihsanihi ilayya keh sakte hain. Yeh tha khulasa muta'akhireen ke qaul ka mahasil, wallahu a'lam. Abu Nasr Ismail bin Hammad Jauhari kehte hain "Hamd" muqabil hai "Zamm" ke. Lehaza yun kehte hain ke hamadtu-r-rajula ahmaduhu hamdan wa mahmadatan fahuwa hameedun wa mahmoodun, tahmeed mein hamd se zyada mubalagha hai. Hamd shukr se aam hai. Kisi mohsin ki di hui nematon par uski sana karne ko shukr kehte hain. Arabi zaban mein shukrtahu aur shukrtu lahu dono tarah kehte hain lekin laam ke sath kehna zyada faseeh hai. Madh ka lafz hamd se bhi zyada aam hai is liye ke zinda, murda balkeh jamadat par bhi madh ka lafz bol sakte hain. Khane aur makan ki aur aisi aur cheezon ki bhi madh ki jati hai, ihsan se pehle, ihsan ke baad, lazim sifaton par, muta'addi sifaton par bhi iska itlaq ho sakta hai, toh iska aam hona sabit hua, wallahu a'lam.

Hamd ki tafseer aqwal-e-salaf se: Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne ek martaba farmaya ke SubhanAllah aur La ilaha illallah aur baaz riwayaton mein hai ke Allahu Akbar ko toh hum jante hain lekin yeh Alhamdulillah ka kya matlab? Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne jawab diya ke is kalma ko Allah Ta'ala ne apne liye pasand farma liya hai aur baaz riwayaton mein hai ke iska kehna Allah ko bhala lagta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh kalma shukr hai, iske jawab mein Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke mere bande ne mera shukr kiya. Is kalma mein shukr ke ilawa uski nematon, hidayaton aur ihsan waghera ka iqrar bhi hai. Ka'ab Ahbar ka qaul hai ke yeh kalma Allah Ta'ala ki sana hai. Zahhak kehte hain yeh Allah ki chadar hai. Ek hadees mein bhi aisa hi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jab tum Alhamdulillah Rabbil Aalameen keh loge toh tum Allah Ta'ala ka shukriya ada kar loge, ab Allah Ta'ala tumhein barkat dega. Aswad bin Saree' ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein arz karte hain ke main ne Zaat-e-Bari Ta'ala ki hamd mein chand ashaar kahe hain agar ijazat ho toh sunaoon, farmaya Allah Ta'ala ko apni hamd bahut pasand hai. (Musnad Ahmad wa Nasai). Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn Majah mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se riwayat hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke afzal zikr La ilaha illallah hai aur afzal dua Alhamdulillah hai. Imam Tirmidhi ne is hadees ko hasan ghareeb kaha hai. Ibn Majah ki ek hadees hai ke jis bande ko Allah Ta'ala ne koi nemat di aur woh us par Alhamdulillah kahe toh di hui nemat, li hui se afzal hogi. Farmate hain agar meri ummat mein se kisi ko Allah Ta'ala tamam duniya de de aur woh Alhamdulillah kahe toh yeh kalma sari duniya se afzal hoga.

Qurtubi farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke sari duniya de dena itni bari nemat nahin jitni Alhamdulillah kehne ki taufiq dena hai is liye ke duniya toh fani hai aur is kalma ka sawab baqi hi baqi hai. Jaise ke Quran-e-Pak mein hai Al-malu wal-banuna al-ayah yani maal aur aulad duniya ki zeenat hai aur nek aamal hamesha baqi rehne wale, sawab wale aur nek umeed wale hain. Ibn-e-Majah mein Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ek shakhs ne ek martaba kaha: Ya Rabbi lakal hamdu kama yambaghi lijalali wajhika wa azimi sultanik, toh farishtay ghabra gaye ke hum is ka kitna ajr likhein. Aakhir Allah Ta'ala se unhon ne arz ki ke tere ek banday ne ek aisa kalma kaha hai ke hum nahin jantay usay kis tarah likhein, Parwardigar ne bawajood jannay ke un se poocha ke us ne kya kaha hai? Unhon ne bayan kiya ke us ne yeh kalma kaha hai, farmaya tum yunhi usay likh lo main aap usay apni mulaqat ke waqt is ka ajr de doon ga. Qurtubi ek jamaat-e-ulama se naqal karte hain ke La ilaha illallah se bhi Alhamdulillah Rabbil Aalameen afzal hai kyunke is mein tauheed aur hamd dono hain. Aur ulama ka khayal hai ke La ilaha illallah afzal hai is liye ke iman-o-kufr mein yahi farq karta hai, is ke kehlwane ke liye kuffar se laraiyan ki jati hain. Jaise ke Sahih Bukhari Muslim hadith mein hai ek aur marfoo hadith mein hai ke jo kuch main ne aur mujh se pehle ke tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram (A.S) ne kaha hai un mein sab se afzal La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ki ek marfoo hadith pehle guzar chuki hai ke afzal zikr La ilaha illallah hai aur afzal dua Alhamdulillah hai. Tirmidhi ne is hadith ko hasan kaha hai, Al-hamdu mein Alif-Lam istighraq ka hai yani hamd ki tamam tar qismein sab ki sab sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye sabit hain. Jaise ke hadith mein hai ke Bari Ta'ala tere hi liye tamam tareefein hain aur tamam mulk hai. Tere hi hath tamam bhalaiyan hain aur tamam kaam teri hi taraf laut-te hain. Rabb kehte hain malik aur mutasarrif ko, lughat mein is ka itlaq sardar aur islah ke liye tabdeeliyan karne wale par bhi hota hai aur in sab ma'ani ke aitbar se Zaat-e-Bari Ta'ala ke liye yeh khoob jachta hai. Rabb ka lafz bhi siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke dusre par nahin kaha ja sakta, haan izafat ke sath ho toh aur baat hai jaise Rabb-ud-Dar yani ghar wala waghera. Baaz ka toh qaul hai ke Ism-e-Azam yahi hai. Aalameen se murad aalameen jama hai aalam ki, Allah Ta'ala ke siwa tamam makhlooq ko aalam kehte hain. Lafz aalam bhi jama hai aur is ka wahid lafz hai hi nahin. Aasman ki makhlooq, khushki aur tari ki makhlooqat ko bhi awalim yani kayi aalam kehte hain. Isi tarah ek ek zamane, ek ek waqt ko bhi aalam kaha jata hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke is se murad kul makhlooq hai khwah aasmanon ki ho ya zameenon ki ya un ke darmiyan ki, khwah hamain is ka ilm ho ya na ho. Ala hazal qiyas. Is se jinnat aur insaan bhi murad liye gaye hain.

Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid aur Ibn Juraij se bhi yeh marwi hai. Hazrat Ali se bhi ghair-motabar sanad se yahi manqool hai. Is qaul ki daleel Quran ki aayat "Liyakoona lil-aalameena nazeeran" bhi di jati hai, yani taake woh aalameen yani jinn aur ins ke liye darane wala ho jaye. Farra aur Abu Ubaid ka qaul hai ke samajhdar ko aalam kaha jata hai. Lehaza insaan, jinnaat, farishtay, shayateen ko aalam kaha jaye ga, janwaron ko nahin kaha jaye ga. Zaid bin Aslam, Abu Muhais farmate hain ke har rooh wali cheez ko aalam kaha jata hai. Qatada kehte hain, har qisam ko ek aalam kehte hain. Ibn Marwan bin Hakam urf Ja'ad jin ka laqab Humar tha jo Banu Umayya mein se apne zamane ke khalifa thay, kehte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne satrah hazar aalam paida kiye hain. Aasmanon wale ek aalam, zameenon wale sab ek aalam aur baqi ko Allah hi janta hai, makhlooq ko un ka ilm nahin. Abul Aaliyah farmate hain insaan kul ek aalam hain, saare jinnaat ka ek aalam hai aur un ke siwa atharah hazar ya chaudah hazar aalam aur hain. Farishtay zameen par hain aur zameen ke chaar konay hain, har konay mein saarhay teen hazar aalam hain, jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne sirf apni ibadat ke liye paida kiya hai. Yeh qaul bilkul ghareeb hai aur aisi baatein jab tak kisi sahih daleel se sabit na hon manne ke qabil nahin hotin. Jameeri kehte hain ek hazar ummatein hain, chhay sau tari mein aur chaar sau khushki mein. Saeed bin Musayyab se yeh bhi marwi hai. Ek zaeef riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ki khilafat ke zamane mein ek saal tiddiyan na nazar aayin balkay talash karne ke bawajood pata na chala. Aap ghamgeen ho gaye, Yaman, Shaam aur Iraq ki taraf sawar doraye ke kahin bhi tiddiyan nazar aati hain ya nahin, toh Yaman wale sawar thori si tiddiyan le kar aaye aur Ameer-ul-Momineen ke samne pesh keen. Aap ne unhein dekh kar takbeer kahi aur farmaya, main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, aap farmate thay Allah Ta'ala ne ek hazar ummatein paida ki hain jin mein se chhay sau tari mein hain aur chaar sau khushki mein. Un mein se sab se pehle jo ummat halak hogi woh tiddiyan hongi, bas un ki halakat ke baad pay dar pay aur sab ummatein halak ho jayengi jis tarah ke tasbeeh ka dhaga toot jaye aur ek ke baad ek sab moti jhar jate hain. Is hadees ke rawi Muhammad bin Isa Hilali zaeef hain. Saeed bin Musayyab R.H se bhi yeh qaul marwi hai. Wahab bin Munabbah farmate hain atharah hazar aalam hain, duniya ki saari ki saari makhlooq un mein se ek aalam hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A farmate hain chalees hazar aalam hain, saari duniya un mein se ek aalam hai. Zajjaj kehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne duniya aakhirat mein jo kuch paida kiya hai woh sab aalam hai. Qurtubi kehte hain ke yeh qaul sahih hai is liye ke yeh tamam aalameen par mushtamil lafz hai. Jaise Firaun ke is sawal ke jawab mein "Rabbul Aalameen kaun hai?" Musa A.S ne farmaya tha ke aasmanon, zameenon aur dono ke darmiyan jo kuch hai un sab ka Rabb.

Aalam ka lafz alamat se mushtaq hai is liye ke aalam yani makhlooq apne paida karne wale aur banane wale par nishan aur us ki wahdaniyat par alamat hai jaise ke Ibn-e-Mu'taz shair ka qaul hai: Faya ajaban kaifa yu'sal-ilah am kaifa yajhaduhul jahid, wa fi kulli shai'in lahu ayatun tadullu ala annahu wahid. Yani ta'ajjub hai kis tarah Allah ki nafarmani ki jati hai aur kis tarah us se inkar kiya jata hai halankeh har cheez mein nishani hai jo us ki wahdaniyat par dalalat karti hai. Alhamdulillah ke baad ab Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim ki tafsir suniye.

Bahut bakhshish karne wala bada meharban. Is ki tafsir pehle puri guzar chuki hai ab iaada ki zaroorat nahin. Qurtubi (R.H) farmate hain aayat (Rabb-ul-Alameen) ke wasf ke baad aayat (Ar-Rahman-ur-Raheem) ka wasf tarheeb yani darawe ke baad targheeb yani umeed hai. Jaise farmaya aayat (Nabbi-e-Ibadi...) yani mere bandon ko khabar do ke main hi bakhshne wala meharban hoon aur mere azaab bhi dardnaak azaab hain. Aur farmaya tera Rabb jald saza karne wala aur meharban aur bakhshish bhi karne wala hai. Rabb ke lafz mein darawa hai aur Rahman aur Raheem ke lafz mein umeed hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein barwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar imandaar Allah ke ghazab-o-ghussa se aur us ke sakht azaab se poora waqif hota to us ke dil se jannat ki tama hat jaati aur agar kaafir Allah Ta'ala ki nematon aur us ki rehmaton ko poori tarah jaan leta to kabhi na-umeed na hota.

Haqeeqi waris malik kaun hai? Baaz qariyon ne 'Malik' parha hai aur baqi sab ne 'Maalik' aur dono qiratein sahih aur mutawatir hain aur saat qiraton mein se hain aur 'Maalik' ne laam ke zer aur us ke sukoon ke sath. Aur 'Maleek' aur 'Maliki' bhi parha gaya hai pehle ki dono qiratein ma'ani ki roo se tarjeeh hain aur dono sahih hain aur achi bhi. Zamakhshari ne 'Malik' ko tarjeeh di hai is liye ke Haramain walon ki yeh qira'at hai. Aur Quran mein bhi aayat (Limanil-mulkul-yaum) (40. Ghafir: 16) aur (Qauluhul-haqqu wa lahul-mulk) (6. Al-An'am: 73) hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) se bhi hikayat bayan ki gayi hai ke unhon ne 'Malik' parha is bina par ke fe'l aur fa'il aur maf'ool aata hai lekin yeh shaaz aur behad ghareeb hai. Abu Bakr bin Dawood (R.H) ne is bare mein ek ghareeb riwayat naqal ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap ke teenon khulafa aur Hazrat Mu'awiya (R.A) aur un ke larke 'Maalik' parhte thay. Ibn-e-Shihab (R.H) kehte hain ke sab se pehle Marwan ne 'Malik' parha. Main kehta hoon Marwan ko apni is qira'at ki sehat ka ilm tha. Rawi-e-hadith Ibn-e-Shihab (R.H) ko ilm na tha wallahu a'lam. Ibn-e-Marduyah (R.H) ne kayi sanadon se bayan kiya hai ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ) 'Maalik' parhte thay. 'Maalik' ka lafz 'Milk' se makhooz hai jaise ke Quran mein hai aayat (Inna nahnu narisul-arda wa man 'alaiha wa ilaina yurja'oon) (19. Maryam: 40) ya'ni zameen aur us ke oopar ki tamam makhlooq ke maalik hum hi hain aur hamari hi taraf sab lota kar laye jayenge. Aur farmaya aayat (Qul a'oozu birabbin-naas, Malikin-naas) (114. An-Naas: 1) ya'ni keh ke main panah pakarta hoon logon ke Rabb aur logon ke maalik ki. Aur 'Malik' ka lafz 'Mulk' se makhooz hai jaise farmaya aayat (Limanil-mulkul-yaum) al-kh ya'ni aaj mulk kis ka hai sirf Allah wahid ghalba wale ka. Aur farmaya aayat (Qauluhul-haqqu wa lahul-mulku yauma yunfakhu fis-soori, 'alimul-ghaibi wash-shahadati wa huwal-hakeemul-khabeer) (6. Al-An'am: 73) isi ka farman hai aur isi ka sab mulk hai. Aur farmaya aaj mulk Rahman hi ka hai aur aaj ka din kafiron par bohat sakht hai. Is farman mein Qayamat ke din ke sath malkiyat ki takhsees karne se yeh na samajhna chahiye ke is ke siwa kuch nahin hai, is liye ke pehle apna wasf Rabb-ul-Aalameen hona bayan kar chuka hai duniya aur aakhirat dono shamil hain. Qayamat ke din ke sath is ki takhsees ki wajah yeh hai ke us din to koi malkiyat ka da'wedar bhi na hoga. Balkeh baghair is haqeeqi maalik ki ijazat ke zaban tak na hila sake ga. Jaise farmaya jis din Rooh-ul-Qudus aur farishtay saf basta kharay honge aur koi kalam na kar sake ga. Yahan tak ke Rahman use ijazat de aur woh theek baat kahe. Doosri jagah irshad hai sab aawazein Rahman ke samne past hongi aur gungunahat ke siwa kuch na sunayi de ga aur farmaya jab Qayamat aayegi us din baghair Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki ijazat ke koi shakhs na bol sake ga. Baaz un mein se badbakht honge aur baaz sa'adat mand.

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain is din us ki badshahat mein us ke siwa koi badshah na hoga jaise ke duniya mein majazan thay. Ayat (Yaum-ud-Din) se murad makhlooq ke hisab ka yani Qayamat ka din hai jis din tamam bhale bure aamal ka badla diya jaye ga, han agar Rabb kisi burai se dargarzar karle yeh us ka ikhtiyari amr hai. Sahaba, Tabi'een aur Salaf-e-Saliheen se bhi yahi marwi hai. Baaz se yeh bhi manqool hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala Qayamat qaim karne par qadir hai. Ibn-e-Jareer ne is qaul ko za'eef qarar diya hai lekin bazahir in dono aqwal mein koi tazad nahin, har ek qaul ka qail dusre ke qaul ki tasdeeq karta hai, han pehla qaul matlab par zyada dalalat karta hai. Jaise ke farman hai Ayat (Al-Mulku Yauma'izin...) aur dusra qaul is ayat ke mushaba hai jaisa ke farmaya Ayat (Wa yauma yaqulu kun fayakun) yani jis din kahe ga "ho ja" bas usi waqt "ho jaye ga", Wallahu A'lam. Haqiqi badshah Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Jaise farmaya Ayat (Huwallahullazi la ilaha illa huwal Malik...). Sahihain mein Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A se marwi hai ke "Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya badtareen naam Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek us shakhs ka hai jo Shahanshah kehlaye, haqiqi badshah Allah ke siwa koi nahin." Ek aur hadith mein hai ke "Allah Ta'ala zameen ko qabze mein le le ga aur aasman us ke dahne hath mein lapte hue honge phir farmaye ga main badshah hoon, kahan gaye zameen ke badshah? Kahan hain takabbur wale?" Quran-e-Azeem mein hai, kis ki hai aaj badshahi? Faqat Allah akele ghalba wale ki. Aur kisi ko Malik keh dena yeh sirf majazan hai jaise ke Quran mein Talut ko Malik kaha gaya aur Ayat (Wa kana wara'ahum malik) ka lafz aaya. Aur Bukhari, Muslim mein mulook ka lafz aaya hai aur Quran ki ayat mein Ayat (Iz ja'ala feekum ambiya'a wa ja'alakum muluka) yani tum mein ambiya kiye aur tumhein badshah banaya, aaya hai. Deen ke ma'ani badle, jaza aur hisab ke hain. Jaise Quran-e-Pak mein hai us din Allah Ta'ala unhein pura pura badla de ga aur woh jaan lenge aur jagah hai Ayat (A'inna lamadeenun) kya hum ko badla diya jaye ga? Hadith mein hai "Dana woh hai jo apne nafs se khud hisab le aur maut ke baad kaam aane wale aamal kare." Jaise ke Hazrat Umar Farooq-e-Azam R.A ka qaul hai ke tum khud apni janon se hisab lo is se pehle ke tumhara hisab liya jaye aur apne aamal ko khud wazan karlo is se pehle ke woh tarazu mein rakhe jayen aur is badi peshi ke liye tayyar ho jao jab tum us Allah ke samne pesh kiye jao ge jis se tumhara koi amal posheeda nahin, jaise khud Rabb-e-Aalam ne farma diya jis din tum pesh kiye jao ge koi chupi dhaki baat chupe gi nahin.

Ibadat ka mafhoom: Saaton qariyon aur jamhoor ne ise "Iyyaka" parha hai. Amr bin Faid ne "Ayyaka" parha hai. Lekin yeh qirat shaz aur mardood hai. Is liye ke "Ayya" ke ma'ani suraj ki roshni ke hain aur baaz ne "Iyyaka" parha hai aur baaz ne "Ayyaka" parha hai aur baaz ne "Hayyaka" parha hai. Arab shairon ke sher mein bhi "Hayyaka" hai. "Nasta'een" ki yahi qirat tamam ki hai. Siwaye Yahya bin Wahab aur A'amash ke. Yeh dono pehle noon ko zer se parhte hain. Qabeela Banu Asad, Rabee'a bint Tameem ki lughat isi tarah par hai. Lughat mein ibadat kehte hain zillat aur pasti ko. Tareeq-e-Mu'abbad us raaste ko kehte hain jo zaleel ho. Isi tarah ba'air-e-mu'abbad us oont ko kehte hain jo bohat daba aur jhuka hua ho aur shariyat mein ibadat naam hai mohabbat, khushoo, khuzoo aur khauf ke majmoo'e ka. Lafz "Iyyaka" ko jo maf'ool hai pehle laye aur phir isi ko dohraya taake is ki ahmiyat ho jaye aur ibadat aur talab-e-madad Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye makhsoos ho jaye to is jumla ke ma'ani yeh hue ke hum tere siwa kisi ki ibadat nahin karte aur na karenge aur tere siwa kisi par bharosa nahin karte aur na karenge. Kaamil ita'at aur poore deen ka hal sirf yahi do cheezein hain. Baaz salaf ka farman hai ke saare Quran ka raaz Surah Fatiha mein hai aur poori surat ka raaz is ayat (Iyyaka na'budu wa Iyyaka nasta'een) mein hai. Ayat ke pehle hissa mein shirk se bezari ka elaan hai aur doosre jumla mein apni taqaton aur quwwaton ke kamaal ka inkaar hai aur Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf apne tamam kaamon ki supurdagi hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si ayatein Quran-e-Pak mein mojood hain. Jaise farmaya ayat (Fa'budhu wa tawakkal alaih) (Surah Hud: 123) yani Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur usi par bharosa karo tumhara Rab tumhare a'amaal se ghafil nahin. Farmaya ayat (Qul huwar-Rahmanu aamanna bihi wa alaihi tawakkalna) (Surah Al-Mulk: 29) keh de ke wahi Rahman hai hum us par imaan le aaye aur usi par hum ne tawakkul kiya. Farmaya ayat (Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi la ilaha illa huwa fattakhizhu wakeela) (Surah Al-Muzzammil: 9) yani mashriq maghrib ka Rab wahi hai us ke siwa koi mabood nahin to usi ko apna karsaaz samajh. Yahi mazmoon is ayat-e-kareema mein hai. Is se pehle ki ayaton mein to khitab na tha lekin is ayat mein Allah Ta'ala se khitab kiya gaya hai jo nihayat latafat aur munasibat rakhta hai is liye ke jab bande ne Allah Ta'ala ki sifat-o-sana bayan ki to qurb-e-Ilahi mein hazir ho gaya, Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ke huzoor mein pahunch gaya, ab is maalik ko khitab kar ke apni zillat aur maskeeni ka izhaar karne laga aur kehne laga ke "Ilah" hum to tere zaleel ghulam hain aur apne tamam kaamon mein tere hi mohtaj hain. Is ayat mein is baat ki bhi daleel hai ke is se pehle ke tamam jumlon mein khabar thi.

Allah Ta'ala ne apni behtareen sifaat par apni sana aap ki thi aur bandon ko apni "sana" inhi alfaaz ke saath bayan karne ka irshad farmaya tha, isi liye us shakhs ki namaz sahih nahin jo is surat ko parhna jaanta ho aur phir na parhe. Jaise ke Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) se marvi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Us shakhs ki namaz nahin jo namaz mein Surah Fatiha na parhe. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marvi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke main ne namaz ko apne aur apne bande ke darmiyan (nisf nisf) baant liya hai, is ka aadha hissa mera hai aur aadha hissa mere bande ke liye hai aur mere bande ke liye woh hai jo woh talab kare. Jab banda aayat (Alhamdulillah-e-Rabbil Aalameen) kehta hai to Allah farmata hai: Mere bande ne meri hamd bayan ki. Jab kehta hai aayat (Ar-Rahman-ur-Raheem) Allah farmata hai: Mere bande ne meri sana ki. Jab woh kehta hai aayat (Maaliki Yaumid-Deen) Allah farmata hai: Mere bande ne meri buzurgi bayan ki. Ibadat aur talab-e-madad. Jab woh aayat (Iyyaka Na'budu wa Iyyaka Nastaeen) kehta hai to Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Yeh mere aur mere bande ke darmiyan hai aur mere bande ke liye woh hai jo woh maange. Phir woh aakhir-e-surat tak parhta hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Yeh mere bande ke liye hai aur mera banda jo mujh se maange us ke liye hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain (Iyyaka Na'budu) ke ma'ani yeh hain ke ae hamare Rabb! Hum khaas teri hi tauheed maante hain aur tujh se darte hain aur teri isi zaat se umeed rakhte hain, tere siwa kisi aur ki na hum ibadat karein, na darein, na umeed rakhein. Aur aayat (Iyyaka Nastaeen) se yeh muraad hai ke hum teri tamam ita'at aur apne tamam kaamon mein tujh hi se madad maangte hain. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka hukm hai ke tum sab isi ki khaalis ibadat karo aur apne tamam kaamon mein isi se madad maango. Aayat (Iyyaka Na'budu) ko pehle lana is liye hai ke asal maqsood Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat hi hai aur madad maangna yeh ibadat ka waseela aur ehtimam aur is par pukhtagi hai aur yeh zahir hai ke zyada ahmiyat wali cheez ko muqaddam kiya jata hai aur is se kamtar ko is ke baad laya jata hai. Wallahu A'lam. Agar yeh kaha jaye ke yahan jama ke seeghay ko lane ki yani "hum" kehne ki kya zaroorat hai? Agar yeh jama ke liye hai to kehne wala to ek hai aur agar ta'zeem ke liye hai to is maqam par nihayat namunasib hai kyunke yahan to maskeeni aur aajizi zahir karna maqsood hai. Is ka jawab yeh hai ke goya ek banda tamam bandon ki taraf se khabar de raha hai. Bilkhusoos jabke woh jamaat mein khara ho ya Imam bana hua ho.

Pas goya woh apni aur apne sab momin bhaiyon ki taraf se iqrar kar raha hai ke woh sab us ke bande hain aur isi ki ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye hain aur yeh un ki taraf se bhalai ke liye aage badha hua hai. Baaz ne kaha hai ke yeh ta'zeem ke liye hai goya ke banda jab ibadat mein dakhil hota hai to isi ko kaha jata hai ke tu shareef hai aur teri izzat hamare darbar mein bahut zyada hai to ab ayat (Iyyaka Na'budu wa Iyyaka Nasta'een) kaha yani apne tayein izzat se yaad kar. Haan agar ibadat se alag ho to us waqt hum na kahe chahe hazaron lakhon mein ho kyunke sab ke sab Allah Ta'ala ke mohtaj aur us ke darbar ke faqeer hain. Baaz ka qaul hai ke ayat (Iyyaka Na'budu) mein jo tawazo aur aajizi hai woh Iyyaka 'Abadna mein nahin is liye ke us mein apne nafs ki badai aur apni ibadat ki ahliyat payi jati hai halankeh koi banda Allah Ta'ala ki poori ibadat aur jaisi chahe waisi sana-o-sifat bayan karne par qudrat hi nahin rakhta. Kisi shayar ka qaul hai (tarjuma) ke mujhe us ka ghulam keh kar hi pukaro kyunke mera sab se achha naam yahi hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka naam 'Abd yani ghulam in hi jaghon par liya jahan apni badi badi nematon ka zikr kiya jaise Quran nazil karna, namaz mein khade hona, me'raj karana waghera. Farmaya ayat (Alhamdu lillahillazi anzala 'ala 'abdi-hil kitaba wa lam yaj'al lahu 'iwaja) (18. Al-Kahf: 1). Farmaya ayat (Wa annahu lamma qama 'abdullahi yad'uhu kadu yakununa 'alaihi libada) (72. Al-Jinn: 19). Farmaya ayat (Subhanallazi asra bi'abdihi lailan minal masjidil harami) (17. Al-Isra: 1). Saath hi Quran-e-Pak ne yeh taleem di ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis waqt tumhara dil mukhalifeen ke jhutlane ki wajah se tang ho to tum meri ibadat mein mashghool ho jao. Farman hai ayat (Wa laqad na'lamu) yani hum jante hain ke mukhalifeen ki baatein tera dil dukhati hain to aise waqt apne Rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd bayan kar aur sajda kar aur maut ke waqt tak apne Rab ki ibadat mein laga reh. Razi ne apni tafsir mein baaz logon se naqal kiya hai ke 'uboodiyat ka maqam risalat ke maqam se afzal hai kyunke ibadat ka ta'alluq makhlooq se Khaliq ki taraf hota hai aur risalat ka ta'alluq Haq se khalq ki taraf hota hai aur is daleel se bhi ke 'abd ki kul islah ke kamon ka mutawalli khud Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala hota hai aur Rasool apni ummat ki maslahaton ka wali hota hai lekin yeh qaul ghalat hai aur us ki yeh dono daleelein bhi bodi aur la-hasil hain. Afsos Razi ne na to is ko za'eef kaha na ise rad kiya. Baaz sufiyon ka qaul hai ke ibadat ya to sawab hasil karne ke liye hoti hai ya azab dafa karne ke liye. Woh kehte hain yeh koi faide ki baat nahin is liye ke us waqt maqsood khud apni murad ka hasil karna thehra. Is ki takaleef ke liye amadgi karna yeh bhi za'eef hai.

Aala martaba-e-ibadat yeh hai ke insaan us muqaddas zaat ki jo tamam kamil sifat-on se mausuf hai, mehez us ki zaat ke liye ibadat kare aur maqsood kuch na ho. Isi liye namazi ki niyat na namaz parhne ki hoti hai, agar woh sawab paane aur azab se bachne ke liye ho toh batil hai. Dusra giroh un ki tardeed karta hai aur kehta hai ke ibadat ka Allah Ta'ala ke liye hona kuch us ke khilaf nahin ke sawab ki talab aur azab ka bachao matloob na ho. Is ki daleel yeh hai ke ek a'arabi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main na toh aap jaisa parhna jaanta hoon na Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) jaisa, main toh Allah Ta'ala se jannat ka sawal karta hoon aur jahannam se nijat chahta hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya isi ke qareeb qareeb hum bhi parhte hain.

Husool-e-maqsad ka behtareen tareeqa: Jamhoor ne 'Sirat' parha hai. Ba'az ne 'Sarat' kaha hai aur 'Zay' ki bhi ek qira'at hai. Farra kehte hain Bani Udhra aur Bani Kalb ki qira'at yahi hai. Chunki pehle sana-o-sifat bayan ki toh ab munasib tha ke apni haajat talab kare. Jaise ke pehli hadith mein guzar chuka hai ke is ka aadha hissa mere liye hai aur aadha mere bande ke liye aur mere bande ke liye woh hai jo woh talab kare. Khayal kijiye ke is mein kis qadar latafat aur umdagi hai ke pehle Parwardigar-e-Aalam ki tareef-o-tauseef ki, phir apni aur apne bhaiyon ki haajat talab ki. Yeh woh lateef andaaz hai jo maqsood ko hasil karne aur muraad ko pa lene ke liye teer-ba-hadaf hai, is kaamil tareeqe ko pasand farma kar Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne is ki hidayat ki. Kabhi sawal is tarah hota hai ke sa'il apni halat aur haajat ko zahir kar deta hai jaise Musa A.S ne kaha tha aayat (Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khairin faqir) Parwardigar jo bhulaiyan tu meri taraf nazil farmaye main us ka mohtaj hoon. Hazrat Yunus A.S ne bhi apni dua mein kaha aayat (An la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin) (21. Al-Anbiya: 87) Ilahi tere siwa koi mabood nahin tu paak hai main zalimon mein se hoon. Kabhi sawal is tarah bhi hota hai ke sa'il sirf tareef aur buzurgi bayan kar ke chup ho jata hai jaise kisi shayar ka qaul hai ke mujhe apni haajat ke bayan karne ki koi zaroorat nahin teri meherbaniyon bhari bakhshish mujhe kaafi hai main jaanta hoon ke daad-o-dahish teri paak aadaton mein dakhil hai lekin teri pakeezgi bayan kar dena, teri hamd-o-sana karna hi mujhe apni haajat poori karne ke liye kaafi hai. Hidayat ke ma'ani yahan par irshad aur taufeeq ke hain. Kabhi toh hidayat banafsihi muta'addi hoti hai jaise yahan hai toh ma'ani hadith (Alhimna, waffiqna, arzuqna aur a'tina) yani hamain ata farmaye honge aur jagah hai aayat (Wa hadaynahun-najdayn) (90. Al-Balad: 10) yani hum ne isay dono raaste dikha diye bhulai aur burai dono ke. Aur kabhi hidayat "ila" ke sath muta'addi hoti hai jaise farmaya aayat (Ijtabahu wa hadahu ila siratim-mustaqeem) (16. An-Nahl: 121) aur farmaya aayat (Fahduhum ila siratil-jaheem) (37. As-Saffat: 23) yahan "hidayat" irshad aur dalalat ke ma'ani mein hai. Isi tarah farman hai aayat (Wa innaka latahdi) al-kh yani tu albatta seedhi raah dikhata hai aur kabhi hidayat 'laam' ke sath muta'addi hoti hai jaise jannatiyon ka qaul Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Alhamdulillahilladhi hadana lihadha wama kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadanallah) (7. Al-A'raf: 43) yani Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne hamain is ki raah dikhai yani taufeeq di aur hidayat wala banaya. Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ke ma'ani suniye. Imam Abu Ja'far Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain muraad is se wazeh aur saaf raasta hai jo kahin se tedha na ho. Arab ki lughat mein aur shairon ke sher mein yeh ma'ani saaf taur par paye jaate hain aur is par beshumar shawahid mojood hain.

Sirat ka istemaal bator-e-isti'ara ke qaul aur fe'l par bhi aata hai aur phir is ka wasf-e-istiqamat aur terha-pan ke sath bhi aata hai. Salaf aur muta'akhireen mufassireen se is ki bahut si tafseerein manqool hain aur in sab ka khulasa ek hi hai aur woh Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itteba aur tabe'dari hai. Sirat-e-Mustaqeem kya hai? Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke Sirat-e-Mustaqeem Kitabullah hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim aur Ibn-e-Jareer ne bhi riwayat ki hai, Faza'il-e-Quran ke bare mein pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki mazboot rassi, hikmaton wala zikr aur seedhi raah yani Sirat-e-Mustaqeem yahi Allah ki kitab Quran-e-Kareem hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad, Tirmidhi, Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur marfoo hadith ka bhi mauqoof hona hi zyada mushaba hai, wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se bhi yahi riwayat hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke Jibra'eel (A.S) ne kaha ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aayat (Ihdinas-Siratal-Mustaqeem) kahiye, yani hamein hidayat wale rasta ka ilham kar aur is Deen-e-Qayyim ki samajh de jis mein koi kaji nahin. Aap se yeh qaul bhi marwi hai ke is se murad Islam hai. Ibn-e-Abbas, Ibn-e-Mas'ood aur bahut se sahaba se bhi yahi tafseer manqool hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain Sirat-e-Mustaqeem se murad Islam hai jo har us cheez se jo aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan hai zyada wus'at wala hai. Ibn-e-Hanafiyya farmate hain is se murad Allah Ta'ala ka woh deen hai jis ke siwa aur deen maqbool nahin. Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam ka qaul hai ke Sirat-e-Mustaqeem Islam hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek hadith mein bhi marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne ek misaal bayan ki ke Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ke dono taraf do deewarein hain, in mein kayi ek khule hue darwaze aur darwazon par parde latak rahe hain, Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ke darwaze par ek pukarne wala muqarrar hai, jo kehta hai ke ae logo! tum sab ke sab isi seedhi raah par chale jao, terhi-tirchi idhar udhar ki raahon ko na dekho na un par jao. Aur is raaste se guzrne wala koi shakhs jab in darwazon mein se kisi ek ko kholna chahta hai to ek pukarne wala kehta hai khabardar ise na kholna. Agar khola to is raah lag jao ge aur Sirat-e-Mustaqeem se hat jao ge. Pas Sirat-e-Mustaqeem to Islam hai aur deewarein Allah ki haddein hain aur khule hue darwaze Allah Ta'ala ki haram karda cheezein hain aur darwaze par pukarne wala Quran-e-Kareem hai aur raaste ke upar se pukarne wala zinda zameer hai jo har imandaar ke dil mein Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se bator-e-wa'iz ke hota hai. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim, Ibn-e-Jareer, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi hai aur is ki asnaad Hasan Sahih hain, wallahu a'lam. Mujahid farmate hain is se murad Haq hai. Un ka qaul sab se zyada maqbool hai aur mazkoora aqwaal ka koi mukhalif nahin. Abu Al-Aliyah farmate hain is se murad Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke baad ke aap ke dono khaleefa hain. Abu Al-Aliyah is qaul ki tasdeeq aur tehseen karte hain, darasal yeh sab aqwaal sahih hain aur ek dusre se mile jule hain.

Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) aur aap ke dono khulafa Siddiq-o-Farooq ka tabe-dar haq ka tabe hai aur haq ka tabe Islam ka tabe hai aur Islam ka tabe Quran ka muti hai aur Quran Allah ki kitab us ki taraf ki mazboot rassi aur us ki seedhi raah hai. Lehaza Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki tafseer mein yeh tamam aqwal sahih hain aur ek dusre ki tasdeeq karte hain. Falhamdulillah. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain: Sirat-e-Mustaqeem woh hai jis par hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne chhora. Imam Abu Jafar bin Jareer (R.H) ka faisla hai ke mere nazdeek is aayat ki tafseer mein sab se aula yeh hai ke hum ko taufeeq di jaye us ki jo Allah ki marzi ki ho aur jis par chalne ki wajah se Allah apne bandon se raazi hua ho aur un par inaam kiya ho, Sirat-e-Mustaqeem yahi hai. Is liye ke jis shakhs ko is ki taufeeq mil jaye jis ki taufeeq Allah ke nek bandon ko thi jin par Allah Ta'ala ka inaam hua tha jo Nabi, Siddiq, Shaheed aur Saleh log thay unhon ne Islam ki aur Rasoolon ki tasdeeq ki, Kitabullah ko mazboot thaam rakha, Allah Ta'ala ke ahkaam ko baja laye. Us ke mana kiye hue kamon se ruk gaye aur Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) aur aap ke charon khalifon aur tamam nek bandon ki raah ki taufeeq mil jaye gi to yahi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem hai. Agar yeh kaha jaye ke momin ko to Allah ki taraf se hidayat hasil ho chuki hai phir namaz aur ghair namaz mein hidayat mangne ki kya zaroorat hai? To is ka jawab yeh hai ke murad is se hidayat par sabit qadmi aur rasookh aur beenai aur hamesha ki talab hai is liye ke banda har sa'at aur har halat mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka mohtaj hai woh khud apni jaan ke nafa nuqsan ka maalik nahin balkay din raat apne Allah ka mohtaj hai isi liye use sikhaya ke har waqt woh Allah Ta'ala se hidayat talab karta rahe aur sabit qadmi aur taufeeq chahta rahe. Bhala aur nek bakht insaan woh hai jise Allah Ta'ala apne dar ka bhikari bana le woh Allah har pukarne wale ki pukaar ke qabool karne ka kafeel hai. Bilkhusoos be-qarar mohtaj aur us ke samne apni haajat din raat pesh karne wale ki har pukaar ko qabool karne ka woh zamin hai. Aur jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein hai. Aayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu aminu billahi wa rasulihi wal-kitabillazi nazzala ala rasulihi wal-kitabillazi anzala min qabl) (Surah An-Nisa: 136). Aye imaan walo Allah par, us ke Rasoolon par us ki us kitab par, jo us ne apne Rasool ki taraf nazil farmayi aur jo kitabein us se pehle nazil huin, sab par imaan lao. Is aayat mein imaan walon ko imaan lane ka hukum dena aur hidayat walon ko imaan lane ka hukum dena aisa hi hai jaise yahan hidayat walon ko hidayat ki talab karne ka hukum dena. Murad dono jagah sabit qadmi aur istimrar hai aur aise aamal par hamishgi karna jo is maqsad ke hasil karne mein madad pahunchayen. Is par yeh aitraz warid ho bhi nahin sakta ke yeh hasil shuda cheez ka hasil karna hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Aur dekhiye Allah Rabbul Izzat ne apne imandar bandon ko hukum diya hai ke woh kahein aayat (رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ ھَدَيْتَنَا وَھَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَھَّابُ) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 8) yani ae hamare Rabb hamare dilon ko hidayat ke baad tedha na kar aur hamein apne paas se rahmat ata farma tu bahut bada dene wala aur ata karne wala hai. Yeh bhi warid hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) namaz-e-Maghrib ki teesri rakat Surah Fatiha ke baad is aayat ko poshidgi se padha karte the, pas aayat (اھدنا الصراط المستقیم) ke ma'ani yeh hue ke Allah hamein Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par sabit qadam rakh aur is se hamein na hata.

In'aam yafta kaun? Is ka bayan pehle guzar chuka hai ke bande ke is qaul par Allah Kareem farmata hai yeh mere bande ke liye hai aur mere bande ke liye hai jo kuch woh mange. Yeh aayat Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki tafseer hai aur nahwiyon ke nazdeek yeh is se badal hai aur atf-e-bayan bhi ho sakti hai, wallahu a'lam. Aur jin par Allah ka in'aam hua un ka bayan Surah Nisa mein aa chuka hai, farman hai aayat: (Wa man yuti'illaha war-rasula fa-ula'ika ma'allazina an'amallahu 'alaihim minan-nabiyyina was-siddiqina wash-shuhada'i was-salihin, wa hasuna ula'ika rafiqa) (4. An-Nisa: 69). Ya'ni Allah aur us Rasool (ﷺ) ke kahe par amal karne wale un ke sath honge jin par Allah ka in'aam hai jo Nabi, Siddiq, Shaheed, Saleh log hain, yeh behtareen sathi aur achhe rafeeq hain. Yeh fazl-e-Rabbani hai aur Allah janne wala kaafi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke Allah Jalla Shanuhu tu mujhe un farishton, nabiyon, siddiqon, shaheedon aur salihin ki raah par chala jin par tu ne apni ita'at-o-ibadat ki wajah se in'aam nazil farmaya. Yeh aayat theek aayat (Wa man yuti'illaha) ki tarah hai. Rabee bin Anas kehte hain is se murad ambiya hain. Ibn Abbas aur Mujahid farmate hain momin hain. Waki' kehte hain musalman. Abdur Rahman farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap ke sahaba murad hain. Ibn Abbas ka qaul zyada ma'qool aur qabil-e-tasleem hai, wallahu a'lam. Jamhoor ki qira'at mein 'ghairi' ke zer ke sath hai aur sifat hai. Zamakhshari kehte hain 'ghaira' re ki zabar ke sath parha gaya hai aur haal hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ki qira'at yahi hai aur Ibn Kathir se bhi yahi riwayat ki gayi hai. 'Alaihim' mein jo zameer hai woh is ka zul-haal hai aur 'an'amta' aamil hai. Ma'ni yeh hue ke Allah Jalla Shanuhu tu hamein seedha rasta dikha un logon ka rasta jin par tu ne in'aam kiya. Jo hidayat aur istiqamat wale thay aur Allah Rasool (ﷺ) ke ita'at guzar, us ke hukmon par amal karne wale, us ke mana kiye hue kamon se ruk rehne wale thay. Maghdoob kaun? Un ki raah se bacha, jin par ghazab-o-ghussa kiya gaya, jin ke irade fasid ho gaye, haq ko jaan kar phir us se hat kar aur gumgashta-e-raah logon ke tariqe se bhi hamein bacha le jo sire se ilm nahin rakhte, mare mare phirte hain, raah se bhatke hue hairan-o-sargardan hain aur raah-e-haq ki taraf rehnumai nahin kiye jane ko dobara la kar kalam ki takeed karna is liye hai ke maloom ho jaye ke yahan do ghalat raste hain, ek Yahood ka dusra Nasara ka. Ba'z nahwi kehte hain ke 'ghair' ka lafz yahan par istisna ke liye hai to istisna munqata' ho sakta hai kyunke jin par in'aam kiya gaya hai un mein se istisna hona to durust hai. Magar yeh log in'aam walon mein dakhil hi na thay lekin hum ne jo tafseer ki hai yeh bahut achhi hai. Arab shairon ke sher mein aisa paya jata hai ke woh mausuf ko hazf kar dete hain aur sirf sifat bayan kar diya karte hain. Isi tarah is aayat mein bhi sifat ka bayan hai aur mausuf mehzoof hai.

Ghair-il-Maghdoobi se murad ghair-e-sirat-il-maghdoobi hai. Muzaf-ilaih ke zikr se kifayat ki gayi aur muzaf bayan na kiya gaya is liye ke nashist-e-alfaz hi is par dalalat kar rahi hai. Pehle do martaba yeh lafz aa chuka hai. Baaz kehte hain aayat (Wala-d-dalleen) mein 'la' zaid hai aur un ke nazdeek taqdeer-e-kalam is tarah hai aayat (Ghair-il-Maghdoobi Alaihim wa-d-dalleen) aur is ki shahadat Arab shairon ke sher se bhi milti hai lekin sahih baat wahi hai jo hum pehle likh chuke hain. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A se aayat (Ghair-il-Maghdoobi Alaihim wa-ghair-id-dalleen) parhna sahih sanad se marwi hai aur isi tarah Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab R.A se bhi riwayat hai aur yeh mahmool hai is par ke in buzurgon se yeh bator-e-tafsir sadir hua. To hamare qaul ki ta'eed hui ke 'la' nafi ki takeed ke liye hi laya gaya hai taake yeh wahi na ho ke yeh 'An'amta Alaihim' par atf hai aur is liye bhi ke dono rahon ka farq maloom ho jaye taake har shakhs in dono se bhi bachta rahe. Ahl-e-Iman ka tareeqa to yeh hai ke haq ka ilm bhi ho aur haq par amal bhi ho. Yahudiyon ke han ilm nahin aur Nasara ke han ilm nahin isi liye Yahudiyon par ghazab hua aur Nasraniyon ko gumrahi mili. Is liye ke ilm ke bawajood amal ko chhorna ghazab ka sabab hai aur Nasrani go ek cheez ka qasd karne ke bawajood sahih rasta ko nahin pa sakte is liye ke un ka tareeqa-e-kar ghalat hai aur itteba-e-haq se hate hue hain yun to ghazab aur gumrahi in dono jamaton ke hissa mein hai lekin Yahudi ghazab ke hissa mein pesh-pesh hain. Jaise ke aur jagah Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (Man la'anahu-llahu wa ghadiba alaihi wa ja'ala minhumul qiradata wal khanasira wa 'abada-t-taghoot) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 60) aur Nasrani zalalat mein barhe hue hain. Farman-e-Ilahi hai. Aayat (Qad dallu min qablu wa adallu kaseeran wa dallu 'an sawa-is-sabeel) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 77) yani yeh pehle hi se gumrah hain aur bahuton ko gumrah kar bhi chuke hain aur seedhi rah se bhatke hue hain. Is ki ta'eed mein bahut si hadeesein aur riwayatein pesh ki ja sakti hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai. Hazrat Adi bin Hatim R.A farmate hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ ke lashkar ne meri phuphi aur chand logon ko giraftar kar ke Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein pesh kiya to meri phuphi ne kaha meri khabar geeri karne wala ghaib hai aur main umr-raseeda burhiya hun jo kisi khidmat ke laiq nahin aap mujh par ehsan kijiye aur mujhe rihayi dijiye. Allah Ta'ala aap par bhi ehsan karega. Huzoor ﷺ ne daryaft kiya ke teri khair khabar lene wala kaun hai us ne kaha Adi bin Hatim aap ne farmaya wahi jo Allah aur Rasool ﷺ se bhagta phirta hai? Phir aap ne use azad kar diya. Jab laut kar aap aaye to aap ke sath ek shakhs the aur ghaliban woh Hazrat Ali R.A the aap ne farmaya lo in se sawari mang lo. Meri phuphi ne un se darkhwast ki jo manzoor hui aur sawari mil gayi. Woh yahan se azad ho kar mere paas aayin aur kehne lagin ke Huzoor ﷺ ki sakhawat ne tere baap Hatim ki sakhawat ko bhi maand kar diya.

Aap ke paas jo aata hai woh khaali haath wapas nahin jaata. Yeh sun kar main bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, main ne dekha ke chhotay bachay aur burhiya auratein bhi aap ki khidmat mein aati jaati hain aur aap un se bhi be-takallufi ke saath boltay hain. Is baat ne mujhe yaqeen dila diya ke aap Qaisar-o-Kisra ki tarah baadshahat aur wajahat ke talab karne walay nahin. Aap ne mujhe dekh kar farmaya, "Adi! Aayat (La ilaha illallah) kehne se kyun bhaagte ho? Kya Allah ke siwa aur koi ibadat ke laiq hai? Aayat (Allahu Akbar) kehne se kyun munh modte ho? Kya Allah Azzawajal se bhi bada koi hai?" Mujh par in kalmaat ne aap ki saadgi aur be-takallufi ka aisa asar kiya ke main foran kalma padh kar musalman ho gaya. Jis se aap bahut khush hue aur farmane lage, aayat (Maghdoobi Alaihim) se murad Yahood hain aur aayat (Ad-Daalleen) se murad Nasara hain. Ek aur hadees mein hai ke Hazrat Adi ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh tafseer irshad farmayi thi. Is hadees ki bahut si sanadein hain aur mukhtalif alfaaz se marwi hai. Banu Qain ke ek shakhs ne Wadi-ul-Qura mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yahi sawal kiya, aap ne jawab mein yahi farmaya. Baaz riwayaton mein un ka naam Abdullah ibn Amr hai, wallahu aalam. Ibn Marduyah mein Abu Zar (R.A) se bhi yahi riwayat hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) aur bahut se sahabiyon se bhi yeh tafseer manqool hai. Rabee bin Anas, Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam waghera bhi yahi farmate hain, balkay Ibn Abi Hatim toh farmate hain mufassireen mein is baare mein koi ikhtilaf hi nahin. In aimma ki is tafseer ki daleel ek toh woh hadees hai jo pehle guzri. Doosri Surah Al-Baqarah ki yeh aayat jis mein Bani Israel ko khitab kar ke kaha gaya hai, aayat (Bi'sama-ash-tarau bihi anfusahum an yakfuru bima anzalallahu baghyan an yunazzilallahu min fadlihi ala man yashau min ibadihi) (2. Al-Baqarah: 90). Is aayat mein hai ke is par ghazab par ghazab nazil hua. Aur Surah Al-Ma'idah ki aayat (Qul hal unabbi'ukum bisharrin min dhalika mathubatan indallahi) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 60) mein bhi hai ke un par ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua aur jagah farman-e-Ilahi hai, aayat (La'analladhina kafaru) yani Bani Israel mein se jin logon ne kufr kiya un par la'nat ki gayi. Dawood (A.S) aur Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ki zabani yeh un ki nafarmani aur had se guzar jaane ki wajah se hai.
