Yeh log kisi burai ke kaam se aapas mein rok-tok nahin karte thay, yaqeenan un ke kaam bahut buray thay. Aur tareekh ki kitabon mein hai ke Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail jabke deen-e-khalis ki talash mein apne sathiyon samet nikle aur mulk-e-Sham mein aaye toh un se yahudiyon ne kaha ke aap hamare deen mein tab tak dakhil nahin ho sakte jab tak ghazab-e-Ilahi ka ek hissa na paalo. Unhon ne jawab diya ke is se bachne ke liye toh deen-e-haq ki talash mein nikle hain, phir ise kaise qabool kar lein? Phir nasraniyon se mile, unhon ne kaha jab tak Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi ka maza na chakh lo tab tak aap hamare deen mein nahin aa sakte.

Unhon ne kaha hum yeh bhi nahin kar sakte chunancha woh apni fitrat par hi rahe. Buton ki ibadat aur qoum ka deen chhod diya lekin yahudiyat ya nasraniyat ikhtiyar na ki. Albata Zaid ke sathiyon ne Isai mazhab qabool kar liya. Is liye ke yahudiyon ke mazhab se yeh milta julta tha. Inhi mein Hazrat Waraqa bin Naufal R.A the unhein Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ki nabuwat ka zamana mila aur hidayat-e-Ilahi ne un ki rahbari ki aur yeh Huzoor ﷺ par iman laye aur jo wahi us waqt tak utri thi us ki tasdeeq ki R.A. Masla: Zaad aur Zoey ki qirat mein bahut bareek farq hai aur har ek ke bas ka nahin. Is liye ulama-e-kiram ka sahih mazhab yeh hai ke yeh farq maaf hai, Zaad ka sahih makhraj toh yeh hai ke zaban ka awwal kinara aur us ke paas ki daarhein aur Zoey ka makhraj zaban ka ek taraf aur samne wale upar ke do daant ke kinare. Dusre yeh ke yeh dono harf majhoora aur rakhwa aur mutbaqa hain pas us shakhs ko jise in dono mein tameez karni mushkil maloom ho, use maaf hai ke Zaad ko Zoey ki tarah padh le. Ek hadith mein hai ke main Zaad ko sab se zyada sahih padhne wala hoon lekin yeh hadith bilkul be-asal aur lapata hai. Al-Hamd ka ta'aruf-o-mafhoom: Yeh mubarak surat nihayat kaar-amad mazameen ka majmua hai in saat ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala ki hamd, us ki buzurgi, us ki sana-o-sifat aur us ke pakeeza namon aur us ki buland-o-bala sifaton ka bayan hai sath hi Qayamat ke din ka zikr hai aur bandon ko irshad hai ke woh us Malik se sawal karein us ki taraf tazarru-o-zari karein apni maskeeni aur bekasi aur bebasi ka iqrar karein aur us ki ibadat khuloos ke sath karein aur us ki tauheed-e-uluhiyat ka iqrar karein. Taake yahi hidayat unhein Qayamat wale din Pul-e-Sirat se bhi paar utare aur nabiyon, siddiqon, shaheedon aur salehon ke pados mein Jannat-ul-Firdous mein jagah dilaye. Sath hi is surat mein nek aamal ki targheeb hai taake Qayamat ke din nekon ka sath mile aur batil rahon par chalne se darawa paida ho taake Qayamat ke din bhi yeh batil parast yahud-o-nasara ki jamaat se door hi rahein. Is bareek nukta par bhi gaur kijiye ke in'aam ki asnaad toh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ki gayi aur 'An'amta' kaha gaya lekin ghazab ki asnaad Allah ki taraf nahin ki gayi yahan fa'il hazf kar diya aur ayat (Maghdoobi Alaihim) kaha gaya is mein Parwardigar-e-Alam ki janab mein adab kiya gaya hai. Dar-asal haqeeqi fa'il Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ghazab-Allahu Alaihim) aur isi tarah zalalat ki asnaad bhi un ki taraf ki gayi jo gumrah hain halanke aur jagah hai ayat (Man yahdillahu fahuwal muhtadi, wa man yudlil fa-ulaika humul khasirun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 178) yani Allah jise rah dikhaye woh rah-yafta hai aur jise woh gumrah kar de us ka rehnuma koi nahin. Aur jagah farmaya ayat (Man yudlilillahu fala hadiya lahu) (Surah Al-A'raf: 186) yani jise Allah gumrah kar de us ka hadi koi nahin woh toh apni sarkashi mein behke rehte hain.

Isi tarah ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain jin se saaf saabit hota hai ke raah dikhane wala gumrah karne wala sirf Subhanuhu wa Ta'ala hi hai. Qadriya firqa jo idhar udhar ki mutashabeh aayaton ko daleel bana kar kehta hai ke bande khud mukhtar hain, woh khud pasand karte hain wahi karte hain. Yeh ghalat hai, sarih aur saaf saaf aayatein un ke radd mein maujood hain lekin baatil parast firqon ka yahi qaida hai ke sarahat ko chhor kar mutashabeh ke peeche laga karte hain. Sahih hadith mein hai ke jab tum un logon ko dekho jo mutashabeh aayaton ke peeche lagte hain to samajh lo ke inhi logon ka Allah Ta'ala ne naam liya hai, tum un ko chhor do. Huzoor ﷺ ka ishara is farman mein is aayat-e-sharifa ki taraf hai. Aayat (Fa-ammallazina fi qulubihim zaighun fayattabi'una ma tashabaha minhu ibtigha'al fitnati wa ibtigha'a ta'wilihi) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 7) yani jin logon ke dil mein kaji hai woh mutashabeh ke peeche lagte hain fitnon aur ta'weel ko dhoondne ke liye. Alhamdulillah, bid'atiyon ke liye Quran-e-Pak mein sahih daleel koi nahin. Quran-e-Kareem to haq-o-baatil, hidayat-o-zalalat mein farq karne ke liye aaya hai, is mein tanaquz aur ikhtilaf nahin. Yeh to Allah-e-Hakeem-o-Hameed ka nazil karda hai.

Aameen aur Surah Fatiha: Surah Fatiha ko khatam kar ke Aameen kehna mustahab hai. Aameen misl Yaseen ke hai aur Aameen bhi kaha gaya hai aur is ke ma'ani yeh hain ke Aye Allah tu qabool farma. Aameen kehne ke mustahab hone ki daleel woh hadith hai jo Musnad-e-Ahmed, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein Wa'il bin Hujr R.A se marwi hai, woh kehte hain main ne suna Rasool Allah ﷺ aayat (Ghairil maghdubi alaihim walad-dalleen) keh kar Aameen kehte the aur aawaz daraz karte the. Abu Dawood mein hai aawaz buland karte the. Imam Tirmidhi is hadith ko Hasan kehte hain. Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki Aameen pehli saff wale log jo aap ke qareeb hote sun lete. Abu Dawood aur Ibn-e-Majah mein yeh hadith hai. Ibn-e-Majah mein yeh bhi hai ke Aameen ki aawaz se masjid goonj uthti thi. Darqutni mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Darqutni batate hain ke Hazrat Bilal R.A se riwayat hai woh Rasool Allah ﷺ se kehte the, mujh se pehle Aameen na kaha kijiye. (Abu Dawood) Hasan Basri R.H aur Jafar Sadiq R.H se Aameen kehna marwi hai. Jaise ke aayat (Aamin-al-bait-al-haram) Quran mein hai. Hamare as-haab waghera kehte hain jo namaz mein na ho use bhi Aameen kehna chahiye. Haan jo namaz mein ho us par takeed zyada hai. Namazi khud akela ho, khwah muqtadi ho, khwah imam ho, har halat mein Aameen kahe. Sahihain mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jab imam Aameen kahe tum bhi Aameen kaho, jis ki Aameen farishton ki Aameen se mil jaye us ke tamam sabqa gunah maaf ho jate hain. Muslim Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jab tum mein se koi apni namaz mein Aameen kehta hai aur farishte aasman mein Aameen kehte hain aur ek ki Aameen dusre ki Aameen se mil jati hai to us ke tamam pehle gunah maaf ho jate hain.

Matlab yeh hai ke us ki Aameen ka aur farishton ki Aameen ka waqt ek hi ho jaye ya muwafiqat se murad qabooliyat mein muwafiq hona hai ya ikhlas mein. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) se marfoo'an riwayat hai ke jab Imam "Walad-Dalleen" kahe toh Aameen kaho Allah qabool farmaye ga. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya Aameen ke kya ma'ani hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah! Tu kar." Jauhari kehte hain is ke ma'ani "Isi tarah ho" hain. Tirmidhi kehte hain is ke ma'ani hain ke hamari ummeedon ko na tod. Aksar ulama farmate hain is ke ma'ani "Aye Allah! Tu hamari dua qabool farma" ke hain. Mujahid, Jafar Sadiq, Hilal bin Sayyaf farmate hain ke Aameen Allah Ta'ala ke naamon mein se ek naam hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marfoo'an bhi yeh marwi hai lekin sahih nahin. Imam Malik (R.H) ke as-hab ka mazhab hai ke Imam Aameen na kahe, muqtadi Aameen kahe kyunke Muwatta Imam Malik ki hadith mein hai ke jab Imam "Walad-Dalleen" kahe toh tum Aameen kaho. Isi tarah un ki daleel ki ta'eed mein Sahih Muslim wali Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ki yeh riwayat bhi aati hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab Imam "Walad-Dalleen" kahe toh tum Aameen kaho. Lekin Bukhari Muslim ki hadith pehle bayan ho chuki ke jab Imam Aameen kahe toh tum bhi Aameen kaho. Aur yeh bhi hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) padh kar Aameen kehte the. "Aameen" ba-awaz-e-buland. Jahri namazon mein muqtadi unchi awaz se Aameen kahe ya na kahe, is mein hamare sathiyon ka ikhtilaf hai jis ka khulasa yeh hai ke agar Imam Aameen kehni bhool gaya ho toh muqtadi ba-awaz-e-buland Aameen kahein. Agar Imam ne khud unchi awaz se Aameen kahi ho toh naya qaul yeh hai ke muqtadi ba-awaz-e-buland na kahein. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) ka yahi mazhab hai. Aur ek riwayat mein Imam Malik (R.H) se bhi marwi hai is liye ke namaz ke aur azkar ki tarah yeh bhi ek zikr hai toh na woh sirf buland awaz se padhe jate hain na yeh buland awaz se padha jaye. Lekin pehla qaul yeh hai ke Aameen buland awaz se kahi jaye. Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ka bhi yahi mazhab hai aur Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) ka bhi dusri riwayat ke aitbar se yahi mazhab hai aur is ki daleel wahi hadith hai jo pehle bayan ho chuki ke Aameen ki awaz se masjid goonj uthti thi. Hamare yahan par ek teesra qaul bhi hai ke agar masjid choti ho toh muqtadi ba-awaz-e-buland Aameen na kahein is liye ke woh Imam ki qira'at sunte hain aur agar badi ho toh unchi awaz se Aameen kahein taake masjid ke kone kone mein Aameen pahunch jaye, Wallahu A'lam. Sahih masla yeh hai ke jin namazon mein unchi awaz se qira'at padhi jati hai un mein unchi awaz se Aameen kehni chahiye. Khwah muqtadi ho, khwah Imam ho, khwah munfarid. Mutarjim, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Yahudiyon ka zikr hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke hamari teen cheezon par Yahudiyon ko itna bada hasad hai ke kisi aur cheez par nahin. Ek toh Jumma ko Allah ne hamein is ki hidayat ki aur yeh behak gaye, dusre Qibla, teesre hamara Imam ke peeche Aameen kehna.

Ibn-e-Majah ki hadith mein yun hai ke Yahudiyon ko salam par aur Aameen par jitni chir hai utni kisi aur cheez par nahin. Aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ki riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tumhara jis qadar hasad Yahudi Aameen par karte hain us qadar hasad aur amr par nahin karte tum bhi Aameen bakasrat kaha karo. Is ki asnaad mein Talha bin Amr rawi zaeef hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein barwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) marwi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Aameen Allah Ta'ala ki mohar hai apne momin bandon par. Hazrat Anas (R.A) wali hadith mein hai ke namaz mein Aameen kehni aur dua par Aameen kehni Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mujhe ata ki gayi hai jo mujh se pehle kisi ko nahin di gayi. Haan itna hai ke Musa (A.S) ki ek khaas dua par Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Aameen kehte thay. Tum apni duaon ko Aameen par khatam kiya karo. Allah Ta'ala inhe tumhare haq mein qabool farmaya karega. Is hadith ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar Quran-e-Kareem ke in alfaaz ko dekhiye jin mein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki dua aayat (رَبَّنَآ اِنَّكَ اٰتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَاَهٗ زِينَةً وَّاَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا) (10. Yunus: 88) hai yani Ilahi tu ne Firaun aur Firauniyon ko duniya ki zeenat aur maal-e-duniya zindagani mein ata farmaya hai jis se woh teri raah se dusron ko behka rahe hain. Allah in ke maal barbad kar aur in ke dil sakht kar, jab tak dard-naak azaab na dekh lein yeh imaan na layein. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki is dua ki qabooliyat ka elaan in alfaaz mein hota hai aayat (قَدْ اُجِيْبَتْ دَّعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَــقِيْمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعٰۗنِّ سَبِيْلَ الَّذِيْنَ لَايَعْلَمُوْنَ) (10. Yunus: 89) yani tum donon ki dua qabool ki gayi. Tum mazboot raho aur be-ilmon ki raah na jao. Dua sirf Hazrat Musa (A.S) karte thay aur Hazrat Haroon (A.S) sirf Aameen kehte thay lekin Quran ne dua ki nisbat donon ki taraf ki. Is se baaz logon ne istidlal kiya hai ke jo shakhs kisi dua par Aameen kahe woh goya khud woh dua kar raha hai. Ab is istidlal ko samne rakh kar woh qayas karte hain ke muqtadi qirat na kare, is liye ke us ka Surah Fatiha ke baad Aameen kehna parhne ke qaim-maqam hai aur is hadith ko bhi daleel mein late hain ke jis ka imam ho to us ke imam ki qirat us ki qirat hai. (Musnad-e-Ahmed) Hazrat Bilal (R.A) kaha karte thay ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Aameen mein mujh se sabqat na kiya kijiye. Is kheencha-tani se muqtadi par jahri namazon mein Al-Hamd ka na parhna saabit karna chahte hain wallahu aalam. (Yeh yaad rahe ke is ki mufassal behas pehle guzar chuki hai). Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab imam aayat (Ghairil maghdoobi alaihim walad-dalleen) keh kar Aameen kehta hai aasman walon ki Aameen zameen walon ki Aameen se mil jaati hai Allah Ta'ala bande ke tamam pehle gunah maaf farma deta hai. Aameen na kehne wale ki misaal aisi hai jaise ek shakhs ek qoum ke saath mil kar ghazwa kare, ghalib aaye maal-e-ghaneemat jama kare, ab qura daal kar hissa lene lage to us shakhs ke naam qura nikle hi nahin aur koi hissa na mile woh kahe "Yeh kyun".

Toh jawab mile tere Aameen na kehne ki wajah se!
